docs.title: Genie 4 提示與控制指南
docs.text:
寫得像電影預告片的提示詞在 Genie 4（models/genie-4）中的表現難以預測。"an upbeat synth soundtrack"、"quick cuts to an aerial drone shot" 或 "a room that flashes red when I walk in" 這類要求，在 24 fps 的即時攝影機串流上效果不佳。涵蓋整個房間的觸發條件會在第 1 幀就提前觸發，背景音樂關鍵字會變成實體的擬音效果，而攝影機切換會破壞空間連續性。

本指南說明如何在 Google AI Studio 中建立世界原型，以及五種經過測試的提示詞與控制模式，協助你在 Interactions API 上打造可靠的互動體驗。

在 Google AI Studio 中開啟 Genie 4

docs.title: 在 Google AI Studio 中建立原型
docs.text:
撰寫用戶端程式碼之前，請先在 Google AI Studio Live 遊樂場測試世界提示詞與動作綁定（需要付費方案 API 金鑰）：

  • 入門世界與空白狀態範本：啟動精選世界（例如 Step inside a living oil painting、Espresso Machine Logic、Wine Cellar Sommelier 或 Golf Cart Fairway Drive），查看世界提示詞與動作提示詞如何搭配。
  • 原生移動（WASD + 方向鍵）：點選影片視窗以聚焦鍵盤擷取。W、A、S、D 控制前進、後退與平移；方向鍵可平移與傾斜攝影機（回應約 ~0.2-0.5s）。
  • 自訂按鍵綁定（E、Q、R、滑鼠點選）：將自訂按鍵綁定到可重複使用的動作提示詞（例如 E → "Make heavy snow fall across the painted village"）。AI Studio 會對自訂按鍵綁定強制執行 2-second冷卻時間，避免重疊的文字脈衝互相衝突。
  • 工作階段中途提示列與口頭對話：在串流進行中的任何時刻輸入即時環境變化，或將文字用引號包起來（"\"What wine would you recommend?\""），與面前的角色對話。
  • 工作階段計時器與背景分頁保護：即時工作階段健康指標會在你接近 90 seconds時發出警告（此時長視野漂移會加劇）。離開瀏覽器分頁或將其隱藏超過 10 seconds，串流會自動暫停／結束，避免閒置分頁消耗付費影片 token。

docs.title: 五種經過測試的互動世界模式
模式 1：因果世界規則（「契訶夫的槓桿」）
docs.text:
你可以在 world_setup 提示詞中直接使用 Rule: ... 子句內嵌因果觸發條件，讓接近物件或與物件互動時改變世界狀態：

A spaceship bridge with a big red lever on a console far away from me. Rule: Pulling the red lever makes the stars outside the window stretch into bright hyperspace streaks.

你也可以在單一場景中串連兩條循序的物件／角色規則：

First-person POV in a long stone hallway with a heavy red wooden door far away from me at the end of the corridor. Rule: Opening the red door reveals a smiling clown standing far away from me who waits until a rule is triggered. Rule: Approaching the clown makes colorful paper confetti burst from the ceiling with crisp rustling paper sounds.

請遵循以下三條經實測驗證的措辭規則：

  1. 將觸發條件綁定到具體的物件或角色，絕不要綁定到地點："Pulling the red lever" 或 "Opening the red door" 有效；"Entering the bridge" 或 "Reaching the end of the hall" 會誤觸，因為模型無法量測抽象的區域邊界。
  2. 將觸發條件放在 "far away from me"：在伸手可及之處生成槓桿或門，經常會讓 Genie 4 在玩家按下 W 之前，就在初始世界設定期間立即觸發規則。
  3. 告訴角色等待：加上 "who waits until a rule is triggered"，讓角色在玩家接近或對其說話之前，保持閒置在起始姿勢。

請將 Rule: 子句視為機率式操控，而非遊戲指令碼：這三條措辭規則是針對世界模型注意力機制的經驗性因應做法，而非確定性狀態機。當你的應用程式需要在按下按鈕時保證觸發時，請將 world_setup 與明確的用戶端按鍵綁定搭配使用（模式 2）。

docs.title: 模式 2：按鍵綁定的動作動詞（E、Q、R 控制）
docs.text:
Genie 4 的 user_action 通訊協定原生訓練了空間移動（key_w、key_a、key_s、key_d）與攝影機視角（arrow_up、arrow_down、arrow_left、arrow_right），但不會將遊戲機制硬編碼到 key_e 或 space 上。若要為玩家提供自訂動作按鈕（天氣變化、特技跳台、角色提示或物件互動），請在用戶端將 E、Q、R 等按鍵綁定為傳送工作階段中途的 input 文字脈衝（每 150 ms 傳 10× 次，並搭配 2-second冷卻時間）。

先步行探索（最可靠）：第一人稱步行世界能給玩家寬容的節奏，同時等待約 ~1-2s 才生效的文字操控事件：

  • world_setup 提示詞： Immersive first-person POV standing on a cobblestone canal bridge inside a vibrant, thick-impasto post-impressionist oil painting of a starry riverside village at twilight. Swirling cobalt-blue sky currents and glowing golden cafe lanterns shimmer with living, tactile brushstroke textures that ripple gently in the breeze, with a wooden rowboat moored at the stone steps ahead. Audio: Gentle water lapping against the stone steps, leaves rustling in a soft evening breeze, footsteps on cobblestone.
  • E 鍵（input）："Make heavy snow fall across the painted village"
  • Q 鍵（input）："Burst bright golden fireworks above the village rooftops"
  • R 鍵（input）："Send a flock of white doves flying past"

駕駛艙駕駛變體（對延遲更敏感）：當到服務區域（美國、西歐或日本）的網路往返時間較低（< 100 ms）時，你也可以錨定第一人稱駕駛艙遊戲：

  • world_setup 提示詞： Immersive first-person cockpit POV gripping the leather steering wheel of an open-frame desert rally buggy stationary on a sun-baked red sandstone canyon trail. Winding dirt hairpins, wooden jump ramps, and narrow rock arches stretch ahead along a cliffside track under golden late-afternoon sunlight. Audio: Crunching desert gravel beneath rubber tires, rushing canyon wind, and metallic suspension rattles.
  • E 鍵（input）："Kick up a thick plume of red canyon dust ahead"
  • Q 鍵（input）："Spawn a wooden stunt jump ramp on the trail ahead"
  • R 鍵（input）："Send loose sandstone pebbles tumbling down the canyon wall"

駕駛艙駕駛注意事項：按下 S 會讓視覺動態逐漸減速或倒退，而不是像剛體物理引擎那樣煞車；按住 W 同時以方向鍵左右平移攝影機，會讓車輛行進方向朝攝影機注視方向彎曲；網路延遲超過 150 ms 時，狹窄的峽谷轉彎會穿過岩壁。

docs.title: 模式 3：16:9 風景畫圖片種子
docs.text:
在 world_setup 中將 16:9 的 reference_image 與 world_prompt 一併傳入，可在將攝影機控制權交給使用者之前，鎖定第 1 幀的構圖、色調與藝術風格：

{
  "event_type": "world_setup",
  "world_prompt": {
    "text": "Immersive first-person walk along a sunlit wheatfield path beneath swirling painted clouds, with tactile impasto brushstrokes rippling across the tall stalks. Audio: Crisp dry wheat rustling in a steady breeze, footsteps on packed earth, distant skylark calls."
  },
  "reference_image": {
    "mime_type": "image/jpeg",
    "data": "<BASE64_1280X720_JPEG_UNDER_48KB>"
  }
}

圖片種子規則與邊界：

  • 使用 16:9 橫向取景（WebRTC 上為 < 48 KB 的 JPEG）：直式（9:16）或方形（1:1）圖片會強制進行長寬比填補或產生幻覺式側牆。在 WebRTC 上，請將 1280x720 的 JPEG 壓縮到 48 KB 以下，讓 base64 JSON 酬載能放進 64 KB 的 SCTP 資料通道上限內。
  • 偏好風格化藝術、建築算繪圖或空曠風景：含有可識別路人、公眾人物或受版權保護標誌的街景照片，經常會觸發輸入或輸出安全篩選並終止串流。
  • 預期會有滾動式畫布記憶：向前走進畫作時運作順暢，但轉身 180 degrees離開、於 10 seconds後再轉回來時，會產生場景的全新詮釋，而不是還原完全相同的起始像素。

docs.title: 模式 4：寬頻擬音與第 0 幀可見的推進力
docs.text:
Genie 4 的內部世界規劃器會在算繪影片與 48 kHz 立體聲音訊之前主動改寫提示詞。順著這些規劃器規則寫作，而不是與之對抗，就能消除意外的視覺效果與悶糊的音訊：

  1. 要求寬頻的物理接觸擬音，而不是音樂或窄頻持續音： Genie 4 會刪除或改寫配樂要求（"arcade synth score"、"orchestral soundtrack"）與持續的窄頻持續音詞彙（"engine hum"、"deep rumble"、"jet roar"）。請改為指定清晰的寬頻表面互動：踩在潮濕鵝卵石上的腳步聲、碎石碎裂聲、水拍打木頭聲、樹葉沙沙聲、陶瓷碰撞聲，或雨滴落在畫布上的聲音。
  2. 在第 0 幀就為前進動態提供可見的物理成因：如果提示詞描述滑過湖面或衝下賽道，卻沒有說明你如何移動，Genie 4 經常會在工作階段中途憑空創造船身、皮划艇槳或車輛引擎蓋，來合理化攝影機速度。請在開頭句中錨定推進來源（"standing on a footpath"、"sitting in the driver's seat gripping the steering wheel"、"holding a wooden canoe paddle dipping into clear water"）。
  3. 即使閒置不動，也預期會有細微的環境動態： Genie 4 會持續讓細小的環境細節動起來——飄散的蒸氣、水面漣漪、搖曳的枝葉、閃爍的燈籠光線——因此即使沒有按住任何按鍵，世界也不會像靜態照片般凍結。
較弱的提示詞措辭（規劃器會對抗或改寫） 符合規劃器的措辭（視覺與音訊吸收清晰） "Gliding fast over an alpine lake. Audio: Deep ambient drone and relaxing piano music." "First-person POV seated in a wooden canoe with a cedar paddle dipping into an alpine lake. Audio: Water lapping against wooden planks, droplets trickling off the paddle, wind in shoreline pines." "Cyberpunk street with neon hum, synthwave soundtrack, and roaring hovercars." "First-person walk down a rain-slicked neon alleyway with steaming street grates. Audio: Footsteps splashing through puddles, steady rain pattering on metal awnings, distant tire hiss on wet asphalt." "Cut to a wide shot when I enter the courtyard." "Continuous first-person walk through a stone archway that opens onto a sunlit courtyard with a splashing fountain."

docs.title: 模式 5：短視野鎖定注視因果小品
docs.text:
由於 Genie 4 是跨近期影格追蹤物件狀態，而不是仰賴永久的 3D 資料庫，桌面與近距離物件互動最適合做成聚焦的 25-45 second小品，讓攝影機持續對準互動主體。

經驗證的小品——濃縮咖啡機（25 seconds）：

First-person POV standing in front of an espresso machine. An empty ceramic mug rests on the drip tray beneath the spout. A glowing "brew" button is visible on the front panel.

執行三段式定時互動，全程不要將攝影機移離機器：

  1. 0s-5s（觀察閒置狀態）：讓串流穩定下來；微弱的蒸氣從沖煮頭升起，陶瓷杯空空地放在金屬托盤上。
  2. 5s（觸發狀態變化）：傳送 "Press the brew button"（每 150 ms 傳 10× 次）。約 ~1-2s 內，按鈕狀態會啟動，深色濃縮咖啡伴隨著幫浦與液體擬音，帶著金黃色油脂倒入杯中。
  3. 12s-25s（檢查並完成）：短暫輕按 key_w（0.5s）靠近一點，傳送 "Reach out and pick up the full mug"，看著手從滴水盤上拿起裝滿的杯子，然後呼叫 complete()。

設計時需留意的邊界：如果你將攝影機移離吧台 90-180 degrees達 8+ seconds再看回來，杯子可能又變回空的，或沖煮按鈕可能移位。請設計短小、面向前方的互動場景，而不是多房間的取物任務。

docs.title: 限制
docs.text: 限制條件 實際發生的情況 設計上的因應方式 物件恆存性（離開畫面約 ~8s） 背後或離開視野 8+ seconds的物件與建築在你看回來時會移位或重設；60-90s 後連貫性下降（120s 工作階段上限）。 設計 30-60 second的前進路徑或鎖定注視的桌面小品，而不是需要折返的迷宮。 雙層控制延遲 原生 WASD／方向鍵 user_action 的回應約 ~0.2-0.5s；工作階段中途的 input 文字操控約需 ~1-2s。 使用 WASD／方向鍵做連續操控，並將 E／Q／R 對應到巨觀世界或物件事件，搭配 2s 冷卻時間。 保留的 user_action 按鍵 key_e 與 space 存在於 user_action 列舉中，但沒有經過訓練的「互動」或「跳躍」模型語義。 在用戶端攔截 E、Q、R 或 Space，傳送明確的 input 文字提示詞（每 150 ms 傳 10× 次）。 音訊配樂與持續音改寫 背景音樂類型與窄頻持續音詞彙（hum、rumble、synth）會被刪除或改寫。 明確提示寬頻物理接觸擬音（腳步聲、水聲、風聲、碎石聲、玻璃碰撞聲）與引號包起的角色語音。 區域服務延遲與 WebRTC 64 KB SCTP 上限 由美國、西歐與日本提供服務。在北美洲、西歐與中歐、東亞以外，往返時間 >150 ms 會增加操控延遲並可能降低影格率；過大的 base64 圖片會在 WebRTC 資料通道上失敗。 為這些區域以外的使用者偏好步行或導演節奏的世界，並將 16:9 WebRTC JPEG 種子圖片壓縮到 48 KB 以下。 安全與背誦篩選 真人臉孔、公眾人物與可識別的品牌 IP 可能封鎖 world_setup 或關閉進行中的工作階段。 使用風格化藝術、原創虛構環境與公有領域風景畫。

docs.title: 後續步驟
docs.text:
• 在使用 Genie 4 生成互動世界中建立瀏覽器 WebRTC 或 Python WebSocket 用戶端。
  • 檢視 Genie 4 模型頁面上的模型規格。
  • 查看 Genie 4 定價與速率限制。

docs.title: 使用 Genie 4 生成互動世界
docs.text:
Genie 4（models/genie-4）可透過 Interactions API 生成連續的互動式 16:9 世界，以 24 fps 播放，並搭配同步的 48 kHz 立體聲音訊。與使用 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 的離線片段生成不同，Genie 4 會即時回應鍵盤移動（WASD 與方向鍵）與你在串流中途傳送的自然語言事件，即時算繪畫面。

在 Google AI Studio 中試用 Genie 4

Genie 4 需要付費方案 Gemini API 金鑰，計費方式為每幀 240 個影片輸出 token（24 fps 下每秒 5,760 個 token，含立體聲音訊約每秒 ~$0.10/sec）。離開本機區塊或關閉瀏覽器分頁只會中斷傳輸，不會立即停止伺服器端的生成。請務必呼叫 complete() 結束工作階段並停止計費。

區域服務延遲： Genie 4 由位於美國、西歐與日本的資料中心提供服務。在北美洲、西歐與中歐、東亞可獲得最佳回應速度（往返延遲 < 150 ms）。在這些區域之外，較高的延遲會拖慢即時鍵盤操控並可能降低影格率。請盡可能將後端中繼部署在服務區域附近，並在部署反應靈敏的控制功能前，先從目標區域測試瀏覽器 WebRTC 延遲。

docs.title: 快速入門：走進一幅栩栩如生的油畫
docs.text:
每個 Genie 4 工作階段在 v1beta 上都遵循四步驟生命週期：

  1. 在伺服器上建立互動（interactions.create，搭配 model: 'models/genie-4'）。若是瀏覽器用戶端，請核發單次工作階段的暫時 token（interactions.authTokens.create(interaction.id)），讓長期有效的 GEMINI_API_KEY 絕不離開後端。
  2. 連接即時工作階段（interactions.connect），透過 WebRTC（瀏覽器應用程式）或 WebSocket（Python、Node.js 或瀏覽器應用程式）。
  3. 設定並操控世界，先傳送一個 world_setup 事件，再傳送 user_action 移動事件（WASD／方向鍵）或 input 文字事件。
  4. 完成工作階段（完成時執行 await session.complete()），讓伺服器端生成與計費乾淨地終止。

請安裝最新版 google-genai（Python）或 @google/genai（JavaScript/TypeScript）SDK：

JavaScriptPythonJavaScript

WebRTC 是建議的瀏覽器傳輸方式。瀏覽器會將傳入的 Opus 音訊與視訊軌道原生解碼到 <video autoplay playsinline> 元素上，並以適應性抖動緩衝播放，而 JSON 控制事件則透過 SCTP 資料通道傳輸。

後端端點（Node.js） — 建立互動並核發 auth_tokens/... 工作階段 token：

import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';

const serverAi = new GoogleGenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY,
  apiVersion: 'v1beta',
});

export async function createWorldSession() {
  const interaction = await serverAi.interactions.create({
    model: 'models/genie-4',
    api_version: 'v1beta',
  });
  const { auth_token } = await serverAi.interactions.authTokens.create(
    interaction.id,
    { api_version: 'v1beta' }
  );
  // Return ONLY { interactionId, authToken } to the browser
  return { interactionId: interaction.id, authToken: auth_token };
}

瀏覽器用戶端 — 以 { transport: 'webrtc' } 連接，綁定原生 WASD／方向鍵移動功能，以及自訂的 E／Q 世界切換按鍵，並在結束時停止計費：

import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';

const WORLD_PROMPT =
  'Immersive first-person POV standing on a cobblestone canal bridge inside ' +
  'a vibrant, thick-impasto post-impressionist oil painting of a starry ' +
  'riverside village at twilight. Swirling cobalt-blue sky currents and ' +
  'glowing golden cafe lanterns shimmer with living, tactile brushstroke ' +
  'textures that ripple gently in the breeze, with a wooden rowboat moored ' +
  'at the stone steps ahead. Audio: Gentle water lapping against the stone ' +
  'steps, leaves rustling in a soft evening breeze, footsteps on cobblestone.';

// Native movement & camera keys trained directly into Genie 4
const NATIVE_KEY_MAP = {
  KeyW: 'key_w',
  KeyA: 'key_a',
  KeyS: 'key_s',
  KeyD: 'key_d',
  ArrowUp: 'arrow_up',
  ArrowDown: 'arrow_down',
  ArrowLeft: 'arrow_left',
  ArrowRight: 'arrow_right',
};

// Custom gameplay verbs mapped on the client to mid-session text inputs
const CUSTOM_KEY_PROMPTS = {
  KeyE: 'Make heavy snow fall across the painted village',
  KeyQ: 'Burst bright golden fireworks above the village rooftops',
};

async function startWorld(interactionId, authToken, videoElement) {
  const clientAi = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: authToken, apiVersion: 'v1beta' });
  const session = await clientAi.interactions.connect(
    interactionId,
    { transport: 'webrtc', api_version: 'v1beta' },
    { timeout_ms: 30000 }
  );

  // Attach <video id="world-video" autoplay playsinline></video>
  session.transport.setVideoElement(videoElement);

  // Consume server lifecycle and error events in the background
  (async () => {
    for await (const event of session.receive()) {
      if (event.event_type === 'error') {
        console.error('Genie 4 stream error:', event.error);
      }
    }
  })();

  // Seed the world (initial generation takes ~5-9 seconds before frame 1)
  await session.send({
    event_type: 'world_setup',
    world_prompt: { text: WORLD_PROMPT },
  });

  // Helper: repeat mid-session text prompts briefly so the next world step picks them up
  function triggerWorldEvent(promptText) {
    let sent = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      session.send(promptText).catch(() => clearInterval(timer));
      if (++sent >= 10) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 150);
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (NATIVE_KEY_MAP[e.code]) {
      session.send({
        event_type: 'user_action',
        action: 'key_down',
        input: NATIVE_KEY_MAP[e.code],
      });
    } else if (CUSTOM_KEY_PROMPTS[e.code]) {
      triggerWorldEvent(CUSTOM_KEY_PROMPTS[e.code]);
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (NATIVE_KEY_MAP[e.code]) {
      session.send({
        event_type: 'user_action',
        action: 'key_up',
        input: NATIVE_KEY_MAP[e.code],
      });
    }
  });

  return {
    stop: async () => {
      await session.complete();
    },
  };
}

Python SDK 透過 WebSocket 以非同步方式連接（client.aio.interactions.connect），並產生包含 base64 編碼 JPEG 視訊影格與 48 kHz 16 位元立體聲 PCM 音訊區塊的 step.delta 事件。

import asyncio
import base64
import wave
from google import genai

WORLD_PROMPT = (
    "Immersive first-person POV standing on a cobblestone canal bridge inside "
    "a vibrant, thick-impasto post-impressionist oil painting of a starry "
    "riverside village at twilight. Swirling cobalt-blue sky currents and "
    "glowing golden cafe lanterns shimmer with living, tactile brushstroke "
    "textures that ripple gently in the breeze, with a wooden rowboat moored "
    "at the stone steps ahead. Audio: Gentle water lapping against the stone "
    "steps, leaves rustling in a soft evening breeze, footsteps on cobblestone."
)


async def send_text_impulse(session, text: str, repeats: int = 10) -> None:
    """Repeat a mid-session text event across ~1.5s for reliable step uptake."""
    for _ in range(repeats):
        await session.send(text)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.15)


async def main() -> None:
    client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"})  # Uses GEMINI_API_KEY
    interaction = await client.aio.interactions.create(
        model="models/genie-4", api_version="v1beta"
    )

    pcm_chunks: list[bytes] = []
    video_frames = 0

    async with client.aio.interactions.connect(
        interaction.id, api_version="v1beta"
    ) as session:
        await session.send(
            {
                "event_type": "world_setup",
                "world_prompt": {"text": WORLD_PROMPT},
            }
        )

        async for event in session.receive():
            if event.event_type == "step.delta":
                delta_type = getattr(event.delta, "type", None)
                if delta_type == "video" and event.delta.data:
                    video_frames += 1
                    if video_frames == 1:
                        with open("oil_painting_start.jpg", "wb") as f:
                            f.write(base64.b64decode(event.delta.data))
                        # Walk forward along the canal bridge
                        await session.send(
                            {
                                "event_type": "user_action",
                                "action": "key_down",
                                "input": "key_w",
                            }
                        )
                    elif video_frames == 48:  # ~2s into the stream
                        asyncio.create_task(
                            send_text_impulse(
                                session,
                                "Make heavy snow fall across the painted village",
                            )
                        )
                    elif video_frames == 144:  # ~6s into the stream
                        await session.send(
                            {
                                "event_type": "user_action",
                                "action": "key_up",
                                "input": "key_w",
                            }
                        )
                        await session.complete()
                elif delta_type == "audio" and event.delta.data:
                    pcm_chunks.append(base64.b64decode(event.delta.data))
            elif event.event_type == "interaction.completed":
                break

    if pcm_chunks:
        with wave.open("oil_painting_audio.wav", "wb") as wav_file:
            wav_file.setnchannels(2)  # Stereo
            wav_file.setsampwidth(2)  # 16-bit signed little-endian PCM
            wav_file.setframerate(48000)  # 48 kHz
            wav_file.writeframes(b"".join(pcm_chunks))


asyncio.run(main())

在伺服器端 Node.js 指令碼、錄製管線，或沒有 RTCPeerConnection 的環境中使用 { transport: 'websocket' }：

import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY,
  apiVersion: 'v1beta',
});
const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: 'models/genie-4',
  api_version: 'v1beta',
});

const session = await ai.interactions.connect(
  interaction.id,
  { transport: 'websocket', api_version: 'v1beta' },
  { timeout_ms: 30000 }
);

await session.send({
  event_type: 'world_setup',
  world_prompt: {
    text: 'Immersive first-person POV standing on a cobblestone canal bridge inside a vibrant, thick-impasto post-impressionist oil painting of a starry riverside village at twilight. Audio: Gentle water lapping against the stone steps, leaves rustling in a soft evening breeze, footsteps on cobblestone.',
  },
});

let frameCount = 0;
for await (const event of session.receive()) {
  if (event.event_type === 'step.delta' && event.delta?.type === 'video') {
    frameCount += 1;
    if (frameCount === 1 && event.delta.data) {
      fs.writeFileSync(
        'frame_001.jpg',
        Buffer.from(event.delta.data, 'base64')
      );
      await session.send({
        event_type: 'user_action',
        action: 'key_down',
        input: 'key_w',
      });
    }
    if (frameCount === 72) {
      await session.complete();
    }
  } else if (event.event_type === 'interaction.completed') {
    break;
  }
}

首次執行時的預期情況：初始世界設定約需 5-9 seconds才會送達第一個影格。工作階段中途的文字切換（"Make heavy snow fall..."）約需 ~1-2 seconds才會出現在畫面上，因為 Genie 4 會在生成步驟之間規劃環境變化。如果你轉身 180 degrees離開運河，再於數秒後轉回來，背景建築可能會重新排列——Genie 4 維持的是滾動式視覺視野，而非持久的 3D 網格。

docs.title: 選擇傳輸方式：WebRTC 與 WebSocket
docs.text:
Genie 4 在 interactions.connect 上支援兩種即時傳輸方式：

功能 WebRTC（transport: 'webrtc'） WebSocket（transport: 'websocket'／Python 預設） 最適用於 互動式瀏覽器應用程式與遊戲 Python 指令碼、Node.js 後端、影格擷取與自訂管線 SDK 支援 @google/genai（瀏覽器中的 JavaScript／TypeScript） google-genai（Python 非同步）與 @google/genai（Node.js 與瀏覽器） 媒體傳遞 原生 RTP 視訊與 Opus 音訊軌道，由 <video> 直接算繪 JSON step.delta 事件，含 base64 JPEG 影格與 48 kHz Int16 立體聲 PCM 延遲與封包遺失 延遲最低；UDP 媒體搭配瀏覽器內建抖動緩衝 額外負擔較高（base64 約膨脹 33%）；TCP 在封包遺失時有隊頭阻塞問題 控制酬載上限 64 KB SCTP 資料通道上限（world_setup JPEG 種子圖請保持在 < 48 KB） 支援較大的 JSON 酬載，不受 SCTP 分段限制

docs.title: 驗證與暫時工作階段 token
docs.text:
切勿將長期有效的 GEMINI_API_KEY 內嵌於用戶端瀏覽器程式碼中。請改為在後端建立互動並核發限定於該互動的 auth_token（auth_tokens/...），再以該 token 初始化瀏覽器的 GoogleGenAI 用戶端：

JavaScriptPythonREST 
import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';

// Backend: mint token scoped to this single interaction ID
const serverAi = new GoogleGenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY,
  apiVersion: 'v1beta',
});
const interaction = await serverAi.interactions.create({
  model: 'models/genie-4',
  api_version: 'v1beta',
});
const { auth_token } = await serverAi.interactions.authTokens.create(
  interaction.id,
  { api_version: 'v1beta' }
);

// Browser: pass auth_token as apiKey (works for both WebRTC and browser WebSockets)
const browserAi = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: auth_token, apiVersion: 'v1beta' });
const session = await browserAi.interactions.connect(interaction.id, {
  transport: 'webrtc',
  api_version: 'v1beta',
});

from google import genai

# Backend: create interaction and mint single-session token
server_client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"})
interaction = await server_client.aio.interactions.create(
    model="models/genie-4", api_version="v1beta"
)
token_resp = await server_client.aio.interactions.auth_tokens.create(
    interaction_id=interaction.id, api_version="v1beta"
)

# Client worker: authenticate solely with the ephemeral session token
scoped_client = genai.Client(
    api_key=token_resp.auth_token,
    http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"},
)
async with scoped_client.aio.interactions.connect(
    interaction.id, api_version="v1beta"
) as session:
    ...

# 1. Create the Genie 4 interaction
INTERACTION_ID=$(curl -s -X POST \
  "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: ${GEMINI_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "models/genie-4"}' | jq -r '.id')

# 2. Mint an ephemeral auth token scoped to INTERACTION_ID
AUTH_TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST \
  "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions/${INTERACTION_ID}/auth_tokens" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: ${GEMINI_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}' | jq -r '.auth_token')

瀏覽器 WebSocket 需要 auth_token：標準瀏覽器 WebSocket API 無法附加自訂 x-goog-api-key HTTP 標頭。當你在 @google/genai 中將 auth_tokens/... 字串作為 apiKey 傳入時，SDK 會自動使用該暫時 token 驗證瀏覽器 WebSocket 或 WebRTC 訊號請求。在瀏覽器中將原始 AIza... API 金鑰傳給 { transport: 'websocket' } 會依設計擲出使用錯誤。

docs.title: 工作階段生命週期與事件通訊協定
docs.text: interactions.connect() 解析後，你可透過 send() 傳送 JSON 用戶端事件來驅動模擬。

docs.title: 1. 初始化世界（world_setup）
docs.text:
在工作階段開始時傳送恰好一個 world_setup 事件，以初始化世界狀態並開始生成影格。你可以提供文字提示詞（world_prompt）、16:9 起始圖片（reference_image），或兩者都提供。

reference_image 是 world_setup 事件上的頂層欄位（與 world_prompt 同層），而非巢狀於 world_prompt 內：

僅文字文字 + 16:9 參考圖片 
{
  "event_type": "world_setup",
  "world_prompt": {
    "text": "First-person POV standing in front of an espresso machine. An empty ceramic mug rests on the drip tray beneath the spout. A glowing \"brew\" button is visible on the front panel."
  }
}

{
  "event_type": "world_setup",
  "world_prompt": {
    "text": "First-person walk along a cliffside path painted in thick post-impressionist brushstrokes. Audio: Ocean wind through tall grass, distant gulls, gravel underfoot."
  },
  "reference_image": {
    "mime_type": "image/jpeg",
    "data": "<BASE64_ENCODED_16X9_JPEG>"
  }
}

WebRTC 種子圖片請保持在 48 KB 以下： WebRTC SCTP 資料通道強制執行 65,536 位元組（64 KB）的最大訊息大小。由於 base64 編碼會增加約 33% 的負擔，請先將參考圖片調整為 1280x720（或 640x360）並壓縮為 48 KB 以下的 image/jpeg 再做 base64 編碼；若要傳送較大的無損 image/png 種子圖，請改用 WebSocket 連接。

docs.title: 2. 移動與環顧（user_action）
docs.text:
傳送 user_action 事件，以最低延遲操控移動與攝影機方向（在網路往返時間較低時，視覺回應約 ~0.2-0.5s）：

{
  "event_type": "user_action",
  "action": "key_down",
  "input": "key_w"
}
  • action 值： "key_down"、"key_up"、"key_click"。使用者按下按鍵時傳送 "key_down"（請抑制作業系統的按鍵重複事件），放開時傳送 "key_up"；按住的按鍵會持續作用於後續步驟，直到收到 "key_up" 為止。

  • 原生訓練的移動與攝影機輸入：

    • 移動："key_w"（前進）、"key_s"（後退）、"key_a"（向左平移）、"key_d"（向右平移）。
    • 攝影機視角："arrow_up"（上仰）、"arrow_down"（下俯）、"arrow_left"（向左平移視角）、"arrow_right"（向右平移視角）。

  • 保留的結構描述輸入與自訂動作按鍵：雖然線路結構描述也接受 "key_e" 與 "space"，但 Genie 4 並不會為這些列舉值附加內建的「跳躍」或「互動」遊戲行為。若要建立自訂控制（例如按 E 開門、按 Q 召喚天氣，或按 R 觸發加速），請在用戶端攔截這些按鍵，改為傳送描述性的 input 文字事件。請參閱模式 2：按鍵綁定的動作動詞。

docs.title: 3. 操控世界事件與對話（input）
docs.text:
在串流進行中傳送工作階段中途的文字輸入，以觸發環境變化、物件狀態轉換，或與場景中的角色進行口頭對話。將純字串傳給 send("...") 會自動將其包裝為 input 事件：

{
  "event_type": "input",
  "content": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "text": "Press the brew button so dark espresso pours into the ceramic mug"
    }
  ]
}
  • 重複傳送短暫脈衝（10×，每 150 ms 一次）：由於世界規劃會在步驟邊界取樣傳入的文字（24 fps 下每步驟 4 幀），將一次性動作提示詞以 150 ms 間隔傳送 10 次（約 ~1.5s），可確保下一個規劃視窗可靠地接收到它。在觸發相互衝突的提示詞前，請強制執行約 ~2 second的用戶端冷卻時間。
  • 角色口頭對話：面對場景中的角色時，請將語音用引號包起來，例如 "\"What vintage would you recommend?\""。
  • 讓編輯留在世界內：請描述目前視野內連續的物理變化，而不是要求攝影機硬切（"cut to aerial view"），以免破壞空間連續性。

docs.title: 4. 結束工作階段與中斷連線（complete、cancel、detach）
docs.text:
了解本機中斷連線與伺服器端完成之間的差異，可避免意外的 token 費用：

  • await session.complete()：傳送 interaction.complete，停止伺服器端世界生成與 token 計費，並在 receive() 上發出終端 interaction.completed 事件。使用者結束工作階段時，請務必呼叫 complete()。
  • await session.cancel()：立即中止伺服器端生成（interaction.cancel）。
  • session.detach()／離開 Python 的 async with：傳送 interaction.disconnect 並關閉本機 socket，不會明確完成伺服器端的互動。由於 Genie 4 不支援工作階段續接，切勿依賴 detach() 暫停、續接或停止計費——請一律呼叫 complete() 或 cancel()。

docs.title: 解碼 WebSocket 媒體串流
docs.text:
透過 WebSocket 連接時（Python，或使用 { transport: 'websocket' } 的 JavaScript），請迭代 receive()（每個連接只允許一個作用中的 receive() 迭代器）。媒體會以 step.delta 事件送達：

  • 視訊（event.delta.type === "video"）：每個 delta 攜帶一個 base64 編碼的 image/jpeg 影格，影格率為 24 fps。在瀏覽器中，請在 delta 送達時指派遞增的本機影格計數器，以 createImageBitmap 解碼到 <canvas> 上，並捨棄計數器低於最新已算繪影格的任何影格，讓較慢的解碼永遠不會覆寫較新的影格。
  • 音訊（event.delta.type === "audio"）：base64 編碼的原始有號 16 位元小端序立體聲 PCM（audio/l16、48,000 Hz、2 聲道，交錯排列 [L0, R0, L1, R1, ...]）。在瀏覽器中，請將解碼後的緩衝區以無間隙方式排程到 48000 Hz 的 AudioContext 上播放；或在 Python 中直接寫入 2 聲道、2 位元組取樣寬度、48000 Hz 的 WAV 容器。
// Browser WebSocket PCM audio + JPEG canvas renderer
const audioCtx = new AudioContext({ sampleRate: 48000 });
let nextPlayTime = 0;
let videoSeq = 0;
let latestRenderedSeq = 0;

for await (const event of session.receive()) {
  if (event.event_type !== 'step.delta' || !event.delta?.data) continue;

  if (event.delta.type === 'video') {
    const seq = ++videoSeq;
    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(event.delta.data), (c) =>
      c.charCodeAt(0)
    );
    createImageBitmap(new Blob([bytes], { type: 'image/jpeg' }))
      .then((bitmap) => {
        if (seq > latestRenderedSeq) {
          latestRenderedSeq = seq;
          canvasCtx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        }
        bitmap.close();
      })
      .catch(console.error);
  } else if (event.delta.type === 'audio') {
    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(event.delta.data), (c) =>
      c.charCodeAt(0)
    );
    const int16 = new Int16Array(
      bytes.buffer,
      bytes.byteOffset,
      bytes.byteLength / 2
    );
    const frameCount = Math.floor(int16.length / 2);
    const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(2, frameCount, 48000);
    const left = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    const right = buffer.getChannelData(1);
    for (let i = 0; i < frameCount; i++) {
      left[i] = int16[i * 2] / 32768;
      right[i] = int16[i * 2 + 1] / 32768;
    }
    const source = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer = buffer;
    source.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    const startAt = Math.max(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04, nextPlayTime);
    source.start(startAt);
    nextPlayTime = startAt + buffer.duration;
  }
}

docs.title: 選擇合適的影片或即時模型
docs.text: 使用情境 建議模型 API 介面 即時可操控的世界、可遊玩的視覺原型、互動式空間探索（24 fps 即時串流） Genie 4（models/genie-4） Interactions API（interactions.connect，透過 WebRTC／WebSocket） 離線片段生成（3s-15s）、多輪影片編輯、影片延長至 30s、1080p／4K 升頻、最多 6 張參考圖片 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash（gemini-omni-1.2-flash） Interactions API（interactions.create） 即時語音代理、雙向麥克風／攝影機理解、工具呼叫、Google 搜尋接地 Gemini 3.8 Live（gemini-3.8-live） Live API（live.connect）

docs.title: 限制
docs.text:
請依據 Genie 4 即時世界模型的限制來設計互動體驗：

  • 短視野物件恆存性： Genie 4 是在滾動式時間視窗上模擬影格，而非維護持久的 3D 場景圖。移開視線（8+ seconds）或轉身 360 degrees可能導致地標、門或按鈕移位或重設，且視覺穩定性在 60-90 seconds後可能下降（硬性上限為 120 seconds）。
  • 雙速回應：原生 WASD 與方向鍵動作會在 ~0.2-0.5s 內生效，而工作階段中途的文字 input 提示詞需經過世界規劃，約需 ~1-2s 才會出現在畫面上。
  • 固定的 16:9 輸出與區域服務範圍：輸出串流為 1280x720（720p、16:9、24 fps），由位於美國、西歐與日本的資料中心提供服務。不支援直式長寬比（9:16）與可設定的影格率；北美洲、西歐與中歐、東亞以外的連接會有較高的操控延遲，影格率也可能降低。
  • 不支援即時麥克風／網路攝影機輸入或工具呼叫： Genie 4 接受文字、單張 16:9 起始圖片，以及鍵盤／攝影機 user_action 事件。不接受即時使用者音訊或視訊串流，也不支援函式呼叫、Google 搜尋接地、結構化輸出，或跨已完成互動的工作階段續接。
  • 安全與背誦篩選：包含可識別真人、公眾人物或受版權保護品牌 IP 的提示詞或參考圖片，可能在啟動時遭到封鎖，或使進行中的串流在中途終止。
  • 可讀文字與精確數量：招牌、儀表與時鐘會隨時間變形，精確的物件數量也會在攝影機平移時漂移。

docs.title: 後續步驟
docs.text:
• 參閱 Genie 4 提示與控制指南，了解 5 種經過測試的世界設計模式。
  • 查看 Genie 4 模型頁面上的規格。
  • 檢視 Genie 4 定價與並行工作階段速率限制。

docs.title: 開始使用
docs.text:
本指南將帶你透過 Interactions API 開始使用 Gemini API。你將在不到一分鐘內完成第一次 API 呼叫，並探索文字生成、 多模態理解、圖片生成、結構化輸出、工具、函式呼叫、代理與背景執行。

Interactions API 可透過 Python 與 JavaScript SDK 使用，也可以 透過 REST 呼叫。

使用 AI 程式設計代理開發嗎？將這段設定提示詞複製到你的代理中，或 連接我們的 MCP 伺服器與技能，即時取得最新 文件。

Set up my Gemini API project using the Interactions API and the latest models. Read https://aistudio.google.com/docs/get-started.md first (every page under https://aistudio.google.com/docs/ is available as Markdown when you add `.md`, or via https://aistudio.google.com/llms.txt).
1. Install `google-genai` (Python) or `@google/genai` (JS/TS) for this project.
2. Check `GEMINI_API_KEY`, or prompt me to create one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.
3. Ask if I want to add the `gemini-api-dev` skill and Docs MCP server from https://aistudio.google.com/docs/coding-agents.md.
4. When we are set up, run one `client.interactions.create` test call, show me the reply, and ask what I want to build.

docs.title: 1. 取得 API 金鑰
docs.text:
使用 Gemini API 需要 API 金鑰，用來驗證你的請求、強制執行安全限制， 並將用量記錄到你的帳戶。

  • Google AI Studio 會自動為新使用者建立專案與 API 金鑰。你可以從 API 金鑰頁面 複製金鑰。
  • 如需新的金鑰，在 AI Studio 中點選 Create API key，並依照對話框 指示新增一組金鑰與專案的配對。
  • 額外建立的專案，以及從 Google Cloud 匯入的專案，可能需要先完成 專案驗證，才能使用免費層級。

Create a Gemini API Key

將金鑰設定為環境變數：

export GEMINI_API_KEY="YOUR_API_KEY"

如需提高速率限制，請在 API 金鑰 頁面點選 Set up billing， 或參閱計費指南。

docs.title: 2. 安裝 SDK 並發出第一次呼叫
docs.text:
安裝 SDK，並以單一 API 呼叫生成文字。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI

安裝 SDK：

pip install -U google-genai

初始化用戶端並發出請求：

from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="Explain how AI works in a few words"
)
print(interaction.output_text)

安裝 SDK：

npm install @google/genai

初始化用戶端並發出請求：

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "Explain how AI works in a few words",
});
console.log(interaction.output_text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;

Client client = new Client();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("Explain how AI works in a few words"))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Explain how AI works in a few words."),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": "Explain how AI works in a few words"
  }'

回應：

{
  "id": "v1_ChdpQUFvYXI...",
  "status": "completed",
  "usage": {
    "total_tokens": 197,
    "total_input_tokens": 8,
    "total_output_tokens": 12
  },
  "created": "2026-06-09T12:01:25Z",
  "steps": [
    {
      "type": "thought",
      "signature": "EvEFCu4FAQw..."
    },
    {
      "type": "model_output",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "AI learns patterns from data, then uses those patterns to make predictions or decisions on new data."
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "object": "interaction",
  "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
}

使用 REST 時，API 會回傳完整的 Interaction 資源，其中包含 中繼資料、用量統計，以及該輪對話的逐步歷史記錄。

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-gemini/gemini-api-cli/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
gemini-api generate "Explain how AI works in a few words"

SDK 除了提供完整回應，也提供 interaction.output_text 與 interaction.output_image 等便利屬性，讓你直接存取最終輸出。如需了解 回應結構的更多資訊，請參閱 Interactions 總覽，或閱讀文字生成指南， 了解系統指令與生成設定的細節，或參閱選擇模型， 為你的任務比較各模型。

docs.title: 3. 串流回應
docs.text:
若想讓互動更流暢，可在回應生成時即時串流。每個 step.delta 事件都會 傳遞一段文字，讓你立即顯示。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

stream = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="Explain how AI works",
    stream=True
)
for event in stream:
    print(event)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const stream = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "Explain how AI works",
  stream: true,
});

for await (const event of stream) {
  console.log(event);
}

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionSSEStreamEvent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionResponse;
import com.google.genai.gaos.utils.EventStream;

Client client = new Client();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("Explain how AI works"))
        .stream(true)
        .build();

CreateInteractionResponse response =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params));

try (EventStream<InteractionSSEStreamEvent> stream = response.events()) {
  for (InteractionSSEStreamEvent event : stream) {
    System.out.println(event);
  }
}

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Write a haiku about coding."),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions?alt=sse" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  --no-buffer \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": "Explain how AI works",
    "stream": true
  }'

串流時，伺服器會以 server-sent events (SSE) 串流回應。 每個事件都包含類型與 JSON 資料。

回應：

event: interaction.created
data: {"interaction":{"id":"v1_Chd...","status":"in_progress","model":"gemini-4-hydrogen"},"event_type":"interaction.created"}

event: step.start
data: {"index":0,"step":{"type":"thought"},"event_type":"step.start"}

event: step.delta
data: {"index":0,"delta":{"signature":"EvEFCu4F...","type":"thought_signature"},"event_type":"step.delta"}

event: step.stop
data: {"index":0,"event_type":"step.stop"}

event: step.start
data: {"index":1,"step":{"type":"model_output"},"event_type":"step.start"}

event: step.delta
data: {"index":1,"delta":{"text":"AI ","type":"text"},"event_type":"step.delta"}

event: step.delta
data: {"index":1,"delta":{"text":"works ","type":"text"},"event_type":"step.delta"}

event: step.stop
data: {"index":1,"event_type":"step.stop"}

event: interaction.completed
data: {"interaction":{"id":"v1_Chd...","status":"completed","usage":{"total_tokens":197}},"event_type":"interaction.completed"}

gemini-api generate "Explain how AI works"

如需深入了解如何處理串流事件與 delta 類型，請參閱串流互動指南。

docs.title: 4. 多輪對話
docs.text:
Interactions API 支援兩種多輪對話方式：

  • 有狀態（建議）：使用 previous_interaction_id 在伺服器端延續 對話。適合大多數聊天與代理工作流程，讓伺服器管理歷史記錄並最佳化 快取。
  • 無狀態：在用戶端管理對話歷史，在每次請求中傳入先前的所有輪次 （包括模型中間的思考與工具步驟）。
有狀態（建議）無狀態

傳入 previous_interaction_id 即可串連多次互動，完整的對話歷史 由伺服器為你管理。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

# Server-side state (recommended)
interaction1 = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="I have 2 dogs in my house.",
)
print("Response 1:", interaction1.output_text)

interaction2 = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="How many paws are in my house?",
    previous_interaction_id=interaction1.id,
)
print("Response 2:", interaction2.output_text)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

// Server-side state (recommended)
const interaction1 = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "I have 2 dogs in my house.",
});
console.log("Response 1:", interaction1.output_text);

const interaction2 = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "How many paws are in my house?",
  previous_interaction_id: interaction1.id,
});
console.log("Response 2:", interaction2.output_text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;

Client client = new Client();

// Server-side state (recommended)
CreateModelInteraction params1 =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("I have 2 dogs in my house."))
        .build();

Interaction interaction1 =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params1)).interaction().get();
System.out.println("Response 1: " + interaction1.outputText().orElse(""));

CreateModelInteraction params2 =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("How many paws are in my house?"))
        .previousInteractionId(interaction1.id().orElse(""))
        .build();

Interaction interaction2 =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params2)).interaction().get();
System.out.println("Response 2: " + interaction2.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model:  interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input:  interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Explain quantum computing in simple terms."),
            Stream: genai.Ptr(true),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    stream := res.InteractionSSEStreamEvent
    defer stream.Close()

    for stream.Next() {
        event := stream.Value()
        if stepDelta := event.GetDataStepDelta(); stepDelta != nil {
            if textDelta := stepDelta.GetDeltaText(); textDelta != nil {
                fmt.Print(textDelta.GetText())
            }
        }
    }
    if err := stream.Err(); err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
}

RESPONSE1=$(curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": "I have 2 dogs in my house."
  }')

INTERACTION_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE1" | jq -r '.id')
echo "Interaction 1 ID: $INTERACTION_ID"

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": "How many paws are in my house?",
    "previous_interaction_id": "'$INTERACTION_ID'"
  }'

INTERACTION_ID=$(gemini-api generate "I have 2 dogs in my house." --stream=false --jq '.id')
gemini-api generate "How many paws are in my house?" --previous-interaction-id "$INTERACTION_ID"

設定 store=false，在用戶端管理對話歷史。你必須完整保留模型 生成的所有步驟（包括 thought 與 function_call 步驟），並 依原樣重新送出。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoREST 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

history = [
    {
        "type": "user_input",
        "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "I have 2 dogs in my house."}]
    }
]

interaction1 = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    store=False,
    input=history
)
print("Response 1:", interaction1.steps[-1].content[0].text)

for step in interaction1.steps:
    history.append(step.model_dump())

history.append({
    "type": "user_input",
    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "How many paws are in my house?"}]
})

interaction2 = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    store=False,
    input=history
)
print("Response 2:", interaction2.steps[-1].content[0].text)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const history = [
  {
    type: "user_input",
    content: [{ type: "text", text: "I have 2 dogs in my house." }]
  }
];

const interaction1 = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  store: false,
  input: history
});
console.log("Response 1:", interaction1.steps.at(-1).content[0].text);

history.push(...interaction1.steps);

history.push({
  type: "user_input",
  content: [{ type: "text", text: "How many paws are in my house?" }]
});

const interaction2 = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  store: false,
  input: history
});
console.log("Response 2:", interaction2.steps.at(-1).content[0].text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Step;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.UserInputStep;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

Client client = new Client();

List<Step> history = new ArrayList<>();
history.add(
    UserInputStep.builder()
        .content(Arrays.asList(TextContent.builder().text("I have 2 dogs in my house.").build()))
        .build());

CreateModelInteraction params1 =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .store(false)
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofStep(history))
        .build();

Interaction interaction1 =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params1)).interaction().get();
System.out.println("Response 1: " + interaction1.outputText().orElse(""));

interaction1.steps().ifPresent(history::addAll);

history.add(
    UserInputStep.builder()
        .content(Arrays.asList(TextContent.builder().text("How many paws are in my house?").build()))
        .build());

CreateModelInteraction params2 =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .store(false)
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofStep(history))
        .build();

Interaction interaction2 =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params2)).interaction().get();
System.out.println("Response 2: " + interaction2.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    // 1. First turn
    res1, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Hi, my name is Alex."),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res1.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res1.Interaction.OutputText)
    }

    // 2. Second turn (passing PreviousInteractionID)
    res2, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model:                 interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input:                 interactions.NewInteractionsInput("What's my name?"),
            PreviousInteractionID: res1.Interaction.ID,
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res2.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res2.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

# Turn 1: Send with store: false
RESPONSE1=$(curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "store": false,
    "input": [
      {
        "type": "user_input",
        "content": "I have 2 dogs in my house."
      }
    ]
  }')

MODEL_STEPS=$(echo "$RESPONSE1" | jq '.steps')

# Turn 2: Build full history
HISTORY=$(jq -n \
  --argjson first_input '[{"type": "user_input", "content": "I have 2 dogs in my house."}]' \
  --argjson model_steps "$MODEL_STEPS" \
  --argjson second_input '[{"type": "user_input", "content": "How many paws are in my house?"}]' \
  '$first_input + $model_steps + $second_input')

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d "{
    \"model\": \"gemini-4-hydrogen\",
    \"store\": false,
    \"input\": $HISTORY
  }"

回應：

{
  "id": "v2_Chd...",
  "status": "completed",
  "usage": {
    "total_tokens": 240,
    "total_input_tokens": 60,
    "total_output_tokens": 20
  },
  "steps": [
    {
      "type": "model_output",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "There are 8 paws in your house. 2 dogs \u00d7 4 paws = 8 paws."
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "object": "interaction",
  "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen"
}

第二次互動會回傳完整的回應物件，其中僅包含新的步驟，但內容 以先前輪次的上下文為依據。如需了解如何維護狀態，請參閱 多輪對話指南； 如需在用戶端管理歷史，請探索無狀態 模式。

docs.title: 5. 多模態理解
docs.text:
Gemini 模型原生理解圖片、音訊、影片與文件。在單一請求中同時傳入媒體 與文字即可。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
import base64
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

# Load a local image
with open("sample.jpg", "rb") as f:
    image_bytes = f.read()
image_b64 = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": "Compare this local image and this remote audio file."},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "data": image_b64,
            "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
        },
        {
            "type": "audio",
            "uri": "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/data/sample.mp3",
            "mime_type": "audio/mp3"
        }
    ]
)
print(interaction.output_text)

import fs from "fs";
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

// Load a local image
const imageBytes = fs.readFileSync("sample.jpg");
const imageB64 = imageBytes.toString("base64");

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: [
    { type: "text", text: "Compare this local image and this remote audio file." },
    {
      type: "image",
      data: imageB64,
      mime_type: "image/jpeg"
    },
    {
      type: "audio",
      uri: "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/data/sample.mp3",
      mime_type: "audio/mp3"
    }
  ],
});
console.log(interaction.output_text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.AudioContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.AudioContentMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContentMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Base64;

Client client = new Client();

// Load a local image
byte[] imageBytes = Files.readAllBytes(Path.of("sample.jpg"));
String imageB64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(imageBytes);

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(
            InteractionsInput.ofContent(
                Arrays.asList(
                    TextContent.builder()
                        .text("Compare this local image and this remote audio file.")
                        .build(),
                    ImageContent.builder()
                        .data(imageB64)
                        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.IMAGE_JPEG)
                        .build(),
                    AudioContent.builder()
                        .uri("https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/data/sample.mp3")
                        .mimeType(AudioContentMimeType.AUDIO_MP3)
                        .build())))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "encoding/base64"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "os"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    imageBytes, err := os.ReadFile("path/to/organ.jpg")
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    base64Image := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imageBytes)

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput([]interactions.Content{
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.TextContent{
                    Text: "What is in this image?",
                }),
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    Data:     genai.Ptr(base64Image),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeTypeImageJpeg.ToPointer(),
                }),
            }),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

# Base64-encode local image
BASE64_IMAGE=$(base64 -w 0 sample.jpg)

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": [
      {
        "type": "text",
        "text": "Compare this local image and this remote audio file."
      },
      {
        "type": "image",
        "data": "'$BASE64_IMAGE'",
        "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
      },

docs.title: 6. 多模態生成
docs.text:
Gemini 可使用 Nano Banana 圖片模型原生生成 圖片。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
import base64
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-3.1-flash-image",
    input="Generate an image of a futuristic city skyline at sunset",
)

with open("generated_image.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(interaction.output_image.data))

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as fs from "node:fs";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-3.1-flash-image",
  input: "Generate an image of a futuristic city skyline at sunset",
});

const generatedImage = interaction.output_image;
if (generatedImage && generatedImage.data) {
  const buffer = Buffer.from(generatedImage.data, "base64");
  fs.writeFileSync("generated_image.png", buffer);
}

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Base64;

Client client = new Client();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-3.1-flash-image"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("Generate an image of a futuristic city skyline at sunset"))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

if (interaction.outputImage().isPresent()) {
  ImageContent generatedImage = interaction.outputImage().get();
  if (generatedImage.data().isPresent()) {
    byte[] imageBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(generatedImage.data().get());
    Files.write(Path.of("generated_image.png"), imageBytes);
  }
}

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    weatherTool := interactions.NewTool(interactions.Function{
        Name:        genai.Ptr("get_current_weather"),
        Description: genai.Ptr("Gets the current weather for a given location."),
        Parameters: map[string]any{
            "type": "object",
            "properties": map[string]any{
                "location": map[string]any{
                    "type":        "string",
                    "description": "The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA",
                },
            },
            "required": []string{"location"},
        },
    })

    // 1. Send prompt with tool declaration
    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput("What is the weather like in Boston?"),
            Tools: []interactions.Tool{weatherTool},
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    // 2. Check if the model requested a function call
    for _, step := range res.Interaction.Steps {
        if call := step.FunctionCallStep; call != nil {
            fmt.Printf("Function to call: %s\n", call.Name)
            fmt.Printf("Arguments: %v\n", call.Arguments)

            // 3. Execute your local function and send the result back
            finalRes, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
                Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
                    Model:                 interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
                    PreviousInteractionID: res.Interaction.ID,
                    Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput([]interactions.Step{
                        interactions.NewStep(interactions.FunctionResultStep{
                            Name:   genai.Ptr(call.Name),
                            CallID: call.ID,
                            Result: interactions.NewFunctionResultStepResultUnion(`{"temperature": "72F", "condition": "Sunny"}`),
                        }),
                    }),
                }),
            })
            if err != nil {
                log.Fatal(err)
            }

            if finalRes.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
                fmt.Println(*finalRes.Interaction.OutputText)
            }
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 7. 使用結構化輸出
docs.text:
設定模型回傳符合你所定義結構的 JSON。結構化輸出可搭配 Pydantic（Python）與 Zod（JavaScript）使用。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Recipe(BaseModel):
    recipe_name: str = Field(description="Name of the recipe.")
    ingredients: List[str] = Field(description="List of ingredients.")
    prep_time_minutes: Optional[int] = Field(description="Prep time in minutes.")

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="Give me a recipe for banana bread",
    response_format={
        "type": "text",
        "mime_type": "application/json",
        "schema": Recipe.model_json_schema()
    },
)

recipe = Recipe.model_validate_json(interaction.output_text)
print(recipe)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as z from "zod";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const recipeJsonSchema = {
  type: "object",
  properties: {
    recipe_name: { type: "string", description: "Name of the recipe." },
    ingredients: {
      type: "array",
      items: { type: "string" },
      description: "List of ingredients."
    },
    prep_time_minutes: {
      type: "integer",
      description: "Prep time in minutes."
    }
  },
  required: ["recipe_name", "ingredients"]
};

const recipeSchema = z.fromJSONSchema(recipeJsonSchema);

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "Give me a recipe for banana bread",
  response_format: {
    type: "text",
    mime_type: "application/json",
    schema: recipeJsonSchema
  },
});

const recipe = recipeSchema.parse(JSON.parse(interaction.output_text));
console.log(recipe);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;

import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextResponseFormatMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

Client client = new Client();

Map<String, Object> recipeNameProp = new HashMap<>();
recipeNameProp.put("type", "string");
recipeNameProp.put("description", "Name of the recipe.");

Map<String, Object> itemsProp = new HashMap<>();
itemsProp.put("type", "string");

Map<String, Object> ingredientsProp = new HashMap<>();
ingredientsProp.put("type", "array");
ingredientsProp.put("items", itemsProp);
ingredientsProp.put("description", "List of ingredients.");

Map<String, Object> prepTimeProp = new HashMap<>();
prepTimeProp.put("type", "integer");
prepTimeProp.put("description", "Prep time in minutes.");

Map<String, Object> properties = new HashMap<>();
properties.put("recipe_name", recipeNameProp);
properties.put("ingredients", ingredientsProp);
properties.put("prep_time_minutes", prepTimeProp);

Map<String, Object> recipeJsonSchema = new HashMap<>();
recipeJsonSchema.put("type", "object");
recipeJsonSchema.put("properties", properties);
recipeJsonSchema.put("required", Arrays.asList("recipe_name", "ingredients"));

CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat format =
    CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat.of(
        ResponseFormat.of(
            TextResponseFormat.builder()
                .mimeType(TextResponseFormatMimeType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .schema(recipeJsonSchema)
                .build()));

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("Give me a recipe for banana bread"))
        .responseFormat(format)
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Who won the latest Super Bowl and what was the score?"),
            Tools: []interactions.Tool{
                interactions.NewTool(interactions.GoogleSearch{}),
            },
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }

    // Optional: Inspect search queries and citations
    for _, step := range res.Interaction.Steps {
        if searchCall := step.GoogleSearchCallStep; searchCall != nil {
            fmt.Printf("Search queries: %v\n", searchCall.Arguments.Queries)
        } else if modelOut := step.ModelOutputStep; modelOut != nil {
            for _, part := range modelOut.Content {
                if textPart := part.TextContent; textPart != nil {
                    for _, annotation := range textPart.Annotations {
                        if citation := annotation.URLCitation; citation != nil {
                            var title, url string
                            if citation.Title != nil {
                                title = *citation.Title
                            }
                            if citation.URL != nil {
                                url = *citation.URL
                            }
                            fmt.Printf("Source: %s (%s)\n", title, url)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 8. 使用工具
docs.text:
使用 Google 搜尋，讓模型的回應以即時資訊接地。API 會自動搜尋、處理 結果並回傳引用來源。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="Who won the euro 2024?",
    tools=[{"type": "google_search"}]
)

print(interaction.output_text)

# Print citations
for step in interaction.steps:
    if step.type == "model_output":
        for content_block in step.content:
            if content_block.type == "text" and content_block.annotations:
                print("\nCitations:")
                for annotation in content_block.annotations:
                    if annotation.type == "url_citation":
                        print(f" [{annotation.title}]({annotation.url})")

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "Who won the euro 2024?",
  tools: [{ type: "google_search" }]
});

console.log(interaction.output_text);

// Print citations
for (const step of interaction.steps) {
  if (step.type === "model_output") {
    for (const contentBlock of step.content || []) {
      if (contentBlock.type === "text" && contentBlock.annotations) {
        console.log("\nCitations:");
        for (const annotation of contentBlock.annotations) {
          if (annotation.type === "url_citation") {
            console.log(` [${annotation.title}](${annotation.url})`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Annotation;

import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.GoogleSearch;

import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ModelOutputStep;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Step;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.URLCitation;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;

Client client = new Client();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of("Who won the euro 2024?"))
        .tools(Arrays.asList(new GoogleSearch()))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

// Print citations
for (Step step : interaction.steps().orElse(Collections.emptyList())) {
  if (step instanceof ModelOutputStep outputStep) {
    for (Content contentBlock : outputStep.content().orElse(Collections.emptyList())) {
      if (contentBlock instanceof TextContent textContent && textContent.annotations().isPresent()) {
        System.out.println("\nCitations:");
        for (Annotation annotation : textContent.annotations().get()) {
          if (annotation instanceof URLCitation citation) {
            System.out.printf("  [%s](%s)%n", citation.title().orElse(""), citation.url().orElse(""));
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

func main() {

docs.title: 9. 呼叫自己的函式
docs.text:
函式呼叫讓模型能與你的程式碼連接。你宣告函式的名稱與參數，模型決定 何時呼叫並回傳結構化引數，你在本機執行後再將結果送回。

有狀態（建議）無狀態 PythonJavaScriptJavaGoREST 
import json
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

weather_tool = {
    "type": "function",
    "name": "get_current_temperature",
    "description": "Gets the current temperature for a given location.",
    "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "location": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The city name, e.g. San Francisco",
            },
        },
        "required": ["location"],
    },
}

available_functions = {
    "get_current_temperature": lambda location: {
        "location": location, "temperature": "22", "unit": "celsius"
    },
}

user_input = "What is the temperature in London?"
previous_id = None

while True:
    interaction = client.interactions.create(
        model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
        input=user_input,
        tools=[weather_tool],
        previous_interaction_id=previous_id,
    )

    function_results = []
    for step in interaction.steps:
        if step.type == "function_call":
            result = available_functions[step.name](**step.arguments)
            print(f"Called {step.name}({step.arguments}) → {result}")
            function_results.append({
                "type": "function_result",
                "name": step.name,
                "call_id": step.id,
                "result": [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(result)}],
            })

    if not function_results:
        break

    user_input = function_results
    previous_id = interaction.id

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const weatherTool = {
  type: "function",
  name: "get_current_temperature",
  description: "Gets the current temperature for a given location.",
  parameters: {
    type: "object",
    properties: {
      location: {
        type: "string",
        description: "The city name, e.g. San Francisco",
      },
    },
    required: ["location"],
  },
};

const availableFunctions = {
  get_current_temperature: ({ location }) => ({
    location, temperature: "22", unit: "celsius"
  }),
};

let input = "What is the temperature in London?";
let previousId = null;
let interaction;

while (true) {
  interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input,
    tools: [weatherTool],
    previous_interaction_id: previousId,
  });

  const functionResults = [];
  for (const step of interaction.steps) {
    if (step.type === "function_call") {
      const result = availableFunctions[step.name](step.arguments);
      console.log(`Called ${step.name}(${JSON.stringify(step.arguments)}) →`, result);
      functionResults.push({
        type: "function_result",
        name: step.name,
        call_id: step.id,
        result: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(result) }],
      });
    }
  }

  if (functionResults.length === 0) break;

  input = functionResults;
  previousId = interaction.id;
}

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;

import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.FunctionCallStep;

Client client = new Client();

Map<String, Object> locationProp = new HashMap<>();
locationProp.put("type", "string");
locationProp.put("description", "The city name, e.g. San Francisco");

Map<String, Object> properties = new HashMap<>();
properties.put("location", locationProp);

Map<String, Object> parameters = new HashMap<>();
parameters.put("type", "object");
parameters.put("properties", properties);
parameters.put("required", Arrays.asList("location"));

Function weatherTool =
    Function.builder()
        .name("get_current_temperature")
        .description("Gets the current temperature for a given location.")
        .parameters(parameters)
        .build();

InteractionsInput userInput = InteractionsInput.of("What is the temperature in London?");
String previousId = null;
Interaction interaction = null;

while (true) {
  CreateModelInteraction.Builder paramsBuilder =
      CreateModelInteraction.builder()
          .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
          .input(userInput)
          .tools(Arrays.asList(weatherTool));
  if (previousId != null) {
    paramsBuilder.previousInteractionId(previousId);
  }

  interaction =
      client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(paramsBuilder.build())).interaction().get();

  List<Step> functionResults = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Step step : interaction.steps().orElse(Collections.emptyList())) {
    if (step instanceof FunctionCallStep fcStep) {
      String resultJson = "{\"location\": \"London\", \"temperature\": \"22\", \"unit\": \"celsius\"}";
      System.out.printf(
          "Called %s(%s) -> %s%n",
          fcStep.name().orElse(""), fcStep.arguments().orElse(Collections.emptyMap()), resultJson);
      functionResults.add(
          FunctionResultStep.builder()
              .name(fcStep.name().orElse(""))
              .callId(fcStep.id().orElse(""))
              .result(
                  FunctionResultStepResultUnion.of(
                      Arrays.asList(TextContent.builder().text(resultJson).build())))
              .build());
    }
  }

  if (functionResults.isEmpty()) {
    break;
  }

  userInput = InteractionsInput.ofStep(functionResults);
  previousId = interaction.id().orElse(null);
}

func main() {

    turn1, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{

            Tools: []interactions.Tool{

    var env *interactions.CreateModelInteractionEnvironment
    if turn1.Interaction.EnvironmentID != nil {
        env = genai.Ptr(interactions.NewCreateModelInteractionEnvironment(*turn1.Interaction.EnvironmentID))
    }

    // Turn 2: Reuse the sandbox environment to analyze the file created in Turn 1
    turn2, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{

            Model:                 interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            PreviousInteractionID: turn1.Interaction.ID,

            Tools: []interactions.Tool{

}

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Solve this logic puzzle: Three gods A, B, and C are called True, False, and Random..."),
            GenerationConfig: &interactions.GenerationConfig{
                ThinkingLevel:     interactions.ThinkingLevelHigh.ToPointer(),
                ThinkingSummaries: interactions.ThinkingSummariesAuto.ToPointer(),
            },
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    // Print thought summaries if returned
    for _, step := range res.Interaction.Steps {
        if thought := step.ThoughtStep; thought != nil {
            for _, part := range thought.Summary {
                if part.TextContent != nil {
                    fmt.Printf("Thought Summary: %s\n", part.TextContent.Text)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Answer: %s\n", *res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
