docs.title: 11. 在背景執行工作
docs.text:
設定 background=True，即可非同步執行長時間工作。使用 interactions.get() 輪詢結果。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
import time
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="Write a detailed analysis of the impact of artificial intelligence on modern healthcare.",
    background=True,
)
print(f"Started background task: {interaction.id}")
print(f"Status: {interaction.status}")

# Poll for completion
while True:
    result = client.interactions.get(interaction.id)
    print(f"Status: {result.status}")
    if result.status == "completed":
        print(f"\nResult:\n{result.output_text}")
        break
    elif result.status == "failed":
        print(f"Failed: {result.error}")
        break
    time.sleep(5)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: "Write a detailed analysis of the impact of artificial intelligence on modern healthcare.",
  background: true,
});
console.log(`Started background task: ${interaction.id}`);
console.log(`Status: ${interaction.status}`);

// Poll for completion
while (true) {
  const result = await ai.interactions.get(interaction.id);
  console.log(`Status: ${result.status}`);
  if (result.status === "completed") {
    console.log(`\nResult:\n${result.output_text}`);
    break;
  } else if (result.status === "failed") {
    console.log(`Failed: ${JSON.stringify(result.errors)}`);
    break;
  }
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000));
}

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionStatus;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.GetInteractionByIdRequest;

Client client = new Client();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(
            InteractionsInput.of(
                "Write a detailed analysis of the impact of artificial intelligence on modern healthcare."))
        .background(true)
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
String interactionId = interaction.id().orElse("");
System.out.println("Started background task: " + interactionId);
System.out.println("Status: " + interaction.status().map(InteractionStatus::value).orElse(""));

// Poll for completion
while (true) {
  Interaction result =
      client.interactions.get(new GetInteractionByIdRequest(interactionId)).interaction().get();
  String status = result.status().map(InteractionStatus::value).orElse("");
  System.out.println("Status: " + status);
  if ("completed".equals(status)) {
    System.out.println("\nResult:\n" + result.outputText().orElse(""));
    break;
  } else if ("failed".equals(status)) {
    System.out.println("Failed: " + result.errors().orElse(null));
    break;
  }
  Thread.sleep(5000);
}

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "time"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, &genai.ClientConfig{HTTPOptions: genai.HTTPOptions{APIVersion: "v1beta"}})
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    // Start a Deep Research agent in the background
    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateAgentInteraction{
            Agent:      interactions.AgentOption("deep-research-preview-04-2026"),
            Input:      interactions.NewInteractionsInput("Research the competitive landscape of solid-state EV batteries in 2026."),
            Background: genai.Ptr(true),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    interaction := res.Interaction
    fmt.Printf("Started research job: %s\n", *interaction.ID)

    // Poll until completion
    for interaction.Status != interactions.InteractionStatusCompleted && interaction.Status != interactions.InteractionStatusFailed {
        time.Sleep(10 * time.Second)
        getRes, err := client.Interactions.Get(ctx, operations.GetInteractionByIDRequest{
            ID: *interaction.ID,
        })
        if err != nil {
            log.Fatal(err)
        }
        interaction = getRes.Interaction
        fmt.Printf("Current status: %s\n", interaction.Status)
    }

    if interaction.Status == interactions.InteractionStatusCompleted {
        if interaction.OutputText != nil {
            fmt.Println(*interaction.OutputText)
        }
    } else {
        fmt.Printf("Research failed: %v\n", interaction.Errors)
    }
}

# Start a background task
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": "Write a detailed analysis of the impact of artificial intelligence on modern healthcare.",
    "background": true
  }')

INTERACTION_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.id')
echo "Started background task: $INTERACTION_ID"

# Poll for completion
while true; do
  RESULT=$(curl -s "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions/$INTERACTION_ID" \
    -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
    -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20")
  STATUS=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.status')
  echo "Status: $STATUS"
  if [ "$STATUS" = "completed" ]; then
    echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.steps[] | select(.type=="model_output") | .content[] | select(.type=="text") | .text'
    break
  elif [ "$STATUS" = "failed" ]; then
    echo "Failed"
    break
  fi
  sleep 5
done

docs.title: Google AI 方案
docs.text:
在 AI Studio 中使用你的 Google AI 訂閱方案。

Google AI Pro 與 Ultra 訂閱方案可在 AI Studio 中提供更高的模型存取權限與更高的速率限制。相較於免費方案，這些方案提供更多資源，可用於原型開發與程式開發。

如要註冊 Google AI 方案，請在 Google AI Studio 中升級。點選左側選單中的 Upgrade。你也可以在 Google AI 方案頁面註冊。

docs.title: 總覽
docs.text:
Google AI Pro 與 Ultra 訂閱可解鎖付費模型與更高的速率限制。這些權益適用於 Google AI Studio Playground，以及 Build 模式中的 Code Assistant 等功能，方便快速進行原型開發。訂閱者可獲得高於免費方案的每日基本配額，可在 Playground 與 Build 介面中使用。每日上限採用重置制，而非滾動時間視窗。這能提供一致的開發體驗，讓你在透過 Cloud Billing 轉入正式環境之前先行開發。

方案 AI Studio 用量 模型存取與權益 Free 配額較低 基本上限與存取權限，包含 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，並可升級以取得更多資源。 AI Pro 配額較高 可存取高階模型，例如 Gemini 4 Argon、Gemini 4 Neon、Gemini Pro、Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 與 Lyria 3.5。 AI Ultra 配額最高 原型開發與程式開發的最高上限，以及 Gemini 4 Carbon 與 Gemini 4 Argon、Gemini 4 Neon 等最先進的前沿模型。

docs.title: Gemini API 用量
docs.text:
當你在 AI Studio 中達到每日訂閱配額時，可以改用 Gemini API 金鑰繼續工作。啟用 Cloud Billing 後，Gemini API 用量將依每次要求計費。你可以在 AI Studio Dashboard 中追蹤各專案與 API 金鑰的 Gemini API 用量。

擁有 Google Cloud 專案並啟用 Cloud Billing 的訂閱者，可以透過 Google Developer Program 取得每月 Cloud 點數。這些點數適用於 Cloud 服務，包括 Gemini API。預付與後付的用量與計費方式維持不變。採用預付計費時，你在 AI Studio 中需要有大於 $0 的已付餘額，才能啟用促銷點數。Google 會優先套用符合資格的 Google Cloud 點數。瞭解詳情。

Google AI 訂閱能協助你展開進階實驗、學習與開發。如要大規模建構應用程式與製作原型，請使用 Starter Tier 專案（如符合資格），或搭配 Gemini API 金鑰的 Google Cloud 專案。

docs.title: 限制與相容性
docs.text:
• 僅限 AI Studio 介面：Google AI 方案針對開發用途的權益，僅適用於 Google AI Studio 網頁介面。Gemini API 的用量（例如使用 API 金鑰或外部應用程式）由 Google 另外計費與管理。不過，你可以在其他 Google 產品中使用你的訂閱（參見 Google AI 方案）。
  • 與 API 計費不同：AI Studio 的 Google AI 方案與 Gemini API 用量級別是分開的，後者涵蓋開發與正式環境的 API 用量。
  • Google One 點數：Google One AI 點數是獨立的點數系統，AI Studio 不支援，也不會與 Google Cloud 點數重疊。
  • Gemini 4 存取權限：Gemini 4 Hydrogen適用於所有方案，包括免費方案。Gemini 4 Carbon在 AI Studio 中需要 AI Ultra 方案（免費與 AI Pro 方案不提供）。Gemini 4 Argon 與 Gemini 4 Neon 適用於 AI Pro 與 AI Ultra（免費方案不提供）。
  • 代理存取權限：Google AI 方案不包含 Deep Research 或 Antigravity Preview 等代理的存取權限。這些功能需要付費 API 金鑰。

docs.title: 後續步驟
docs.text:

  • 瞭解 Starter Tier。
  • 瞭解 Gemini API 計費與用量級別。
  • 探索可用的 Gemini 模型。

docs.title: 使用 Google 搜尋接地
docs.text:
使用 Google 搜尋接地可將 Gemini 模型連結至即時網路內容，且支援所有可用語言。這讓 Gemini 能提供更準確的答案，並引用可驗證的來源，涵蓋其知識截止日期之後的資訊。

接地可協助你建構具備以下能力的應用程式：

  • 提高事實準確性：以真實世界的資訊為回覆依據，減少模型幻覺。

  • 存取即時資訊：回答關於近期事件與主題的問題。

  • 提供引用來源：展示模型主張的來源，建立使用者信任。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoREST 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input="Who won the euro 2024?",
    tools=[{"type": "google_search"}]
)

print(interaction.output_text)

    input: "Who won the euro 2024?",
    tools: [{ type: "google_search" }]
});

console.log(interaction.output_text);

docs.title: Google 搜尋接地的運作方式
docs.text:
啟用 google_search 工具後，模型會自動處理搜尋、處理資訊與引用資訊的整個工作流程。

  1. 使用者提示詞：你的應用程式將使用者的提示詞連同已啟用的 google_search 工具傳送至 Gemini API。

  2. 提示詞分析：模型會分析提示詞，判斷 Google 搜尋是否能改善答案。

  3. Google 搜尋：如有需要，模型會自動產生一或多個搜尋查詢並執行。

  4. 搜尋結果處理：模型會處理搜尋結果、彙整資訊，並形成回覆。

  5. 接地回覆：API 會傳回最終且易於使用者理解的回覆，該回覆以搜尋結果為依據。此回覆包含模型的文字答案，其中附有含引用來源的行內 annotations，以及包含搜尋查詢與搜尋建議的 google_search_call 與 google_search_result 步驟。

docs.title: 瞭解接地回覆
docs.text:
回覆成功接地後，模型的文字輸出會在文字內容區塊上直接包含行內 annotations。這些註解提供引用資訊，將回覆的部分內容連結至其來源。

{
  "steps": [
    {
      "type": "thought",
      "summary": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "The user is asking for the winner of Euro 2024. I need to search for the result of the Euro 2024 final."
        }
      ],
      "signature": "CoMDAXLI2nynRYojJIy6B1Jh9os2crpWLfB0..."
    },
    {
      "type": "google_search_call",
      "arguments": {
        "queries": ["UEFA Euro 2024 winner"]
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "google_search_result",
      "call_id": "search_001",
      "result": [
        {
          "search_suggestions": "<!-- HTML and CSS for the search widget -->"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "model_output",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "Spain won Euro 2024, defeating England 2-1 in the final. This victory marks Spain's record fourth European Championship title.",
          "annotations": [
            {
              "type": "url_citation",
              "url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/euro-2024-final",
              "title": "aljazeera.com",
              "start_index": 0,
              "end_index": 56
            },
            {
              "type": "url_citation",
              "url": "https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/news/spain-wins-euro-2024",
              "title": "uefa.com",
              "start_index": 57,
              "end_index": 124
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

回覆中的關鍵欄位：

  • google_search_call：包含模型執行的搜尋 queries。

  • google_search_result：包含 search_suggestions，這是一段 HTML 程式碼片段，可用於在你的 UI 中算繪搜尋建議。完整的使用規定詳見服務條款。

  • text 與其 annotations：模型彙整的答案，附有行內引用。每個 url_citation 註解會將一段文字（由 start_index 與 end_index 定義）連結至來源 URL。這是建立行內引用的關鍵。

Google 搜尋接地也可以與 URL 上下文工具搭配使用，讓回覆同時以公開網路資料與你提供的特定 URL 為依據。

docs.title: 以行內引用標示來源
docs.text:
API 會在文字內容區塊上傳回行內 url_citation 註解，讓你完全掌控在使用者介面中顯示來源的方式。每個註解都包含 start_index 與 end_index，用以識別它所引用的文字部分。以下是擷取與顯示這些註解的方法。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGo 
for step in interaction.steps:
    if step.type == "model_output":
        for content_block in step.content:
            if content_block.type == "text":
                print(content_block.text)
                if content_block.annotations:
                    print("\nCitations:")
                    for annotation in content_block.annotations:
                        if annotation.type == "url_citation":
                            cited_text = content_block.text[annotation.start_index:annotation.end_index]
                            print(f" [{annotation.title}]({annotation.url})")
                            print(f" Cited text: \"{cited_text}\"")

for (const step of interaction.steps) {
  if (step.type === 'model_output') {
    for (const contentBlock of step.content || []) {
      if (contentBlock.type === 'text') {
        console.log(contentBlock.text);
        if (contentBlock.annotations) {
          console.log("\nCitations:");
          for (const annotation of contentBlock.annotations) {
            if (annotation.type === 'url_citation') {
              const citedText = contentBlock.text.slice(annotation.startIndex, annotation.endIndex);
              console.log(` [${annotation.title}](${annotation.url})`);
              console.log(` Cited text: "${citedText}"`);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

if (interaction.steps().isPresent()) {
  for (Step step : interaction.steps().get()) {
    if (step instanceof ModelOutputStep) {
      ModelOutputStep outputStep = (ModelOutputStep) step;
      if (outputStep.content().isPresent()) {
        for (Content contentBlock : outputStep.content().get()) {
          if (contentBlock instanceof TextContent) {
            TextContent textContent = (TextContent) contentBlock;
            String text = textContent.text().orElse("");
            System.out.println(text);
            if (textContent.annotations().isPresent()
                && !textContent.annotations().get().isEmpty()) {
              System.out.println("\nCitations:");
              for (Annotation annotation : textContent.annotations().get()) {
                if (annotation instanceof URLCitation) {
                  URLCitation citation = (URLCitation) annotation;
                  int start = citation.startIndex().orElse(0);
                  int end = citation.endIndex().orElse(0);
                  String citedText =
                      (start >= 0 && end <= text.length() && start <= end)
                          ? text.substring(start, end)
                          : "";
                  System.out.printf(
                      "  [%s](%s)%n", citation.title().orElse(""), citation.url().orElse(""));
                  System.out.printf("    Cited text: \"%s\"%n", citedText);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

                                }
                                citedText := ""

docs.title: 定價
docs.text:
使用 Gemini 3 與更新模型的 Google 搜尋接地時，系統會針對模型決定執行的每一次搜尋查詢向你的專案計費。這種依查詢計費的模式包含每月 5,000 次免費搜尋要求（由所有 Gemini 3 與更新模型共用），之後的費率為每 1,000 次搜尋要求 $14。

舉例來說，如果模型決定執行多次搜尋查詢來回答單一提示詞（例如在同一次 API 呼叫中搜尋 "UEFA Euro 2024 winner" 與 "Spain vs England Euro 2024 final score"），該次要求就會計算為兩次工具的計費用量。基於計費目的，計算不重複查詢時會忽略空白的網路搜尋查詢。

使用 Gemini 2.5 或較舊模型的搜尋接地時，系統會依提示詞向你的專案計費。

如需詳細定價資訊，請參閱 Gemini API 定價頁面。

注意：在 Gemini Developer API 的付費級別中，Gemini 3 與更新模型的 Google 搜尋接地預設上限為每個專案每天 1,500 次要求（RPD）。如果你的應用程式需要更高的每日上限，請在 Google AI Studio 中提出申請（在 generate_content_search_request_paid 上限旁選取 Request more quota）。

docs.title: Nano Banana 圖像生成
docs.text:
在 Google AI Studio 中試用

Nano Banana 是 Gemini 原生圖像生成功能的名稱。Gemini 能以對話方式生成與處理圖像，可搭配文字、圖像、影片或三者的組合，讓你以前所未有的掌控程度建立、編輯並反覆調整視覺內容。

docs.title: 模型選用
docs.text:
Nano Banana 指的是 Gemini API 中提供的下列模型：

  • Nano Banana 2.1：Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 模型（gemini-nano-banana-2.1）。這是 Nano Banana 2 的更新版，是圖像生成與對話式編輯的主力高效模型。它維持 Flash 等級的速度與成本效率，同時在 1K、2K 與 4K 解析度下提供更佳的視覺品質、文字算繪、多輪一致性，以及 Google 搜尋接地。

  • Nano Banana 2 Lite：Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image 模型（gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image）。這是最快、最便宜的 Gemini 圖像模型，專為速度與規模而設計，適用於速度與成本為首要考量的情境。它並未針對多張參考輸入或多輪連續編輯最佳化。

  • Nano Banana 2：Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 模型（gemini-3.1-flash-image）。這是上一代的高效主力模型，針對速度、4K 生成與多張參考圖像的一致性最佳化。所有新專案建議改用 Nano Banana 2.1。

  • Nano Banana Pro：Gemini 3 Pro Image 模型（gemini-3-pro-image）。這是處理複雜視覺任務的頂級選擇，運用進階推理（「Thinking」）來遵循複雜指令、維持品牌一致性，並算繪高擬真文字。

  • Nano Banana：Gemini 2.5 Flash Image 模型（gemini-2.5-flash-image）。這是 Nano Banana 系列的舊版模型。建議的遷移路徑是 Nano Banana 2 Lite，可獲得更高的品質、更快的速度與更低的價格。

所有生成的圖像都包含 SynthID 浮水印。

圖像編輯（文字與圖像轉圖像）{#gemini-image-editing}
docs.text:
Reminder：請確認你對上傳的任何圖像都擁有必要的權利。請勿生成侵犯他人權利的內容，包括欺騙、騷擾或傷害他人的影片或圖像。你使用這項生成式 AI 服務須遵守我們的禁止使用政策。

提供一張圖像，並使用文字提示詞來新增、移除或修改元素、變更風格，或調整調色。

下列範例示範如何上傳以 base64 編碼的圖像。如需多張圖像、較大的酬載與支援的 MIME 類型，請參閱圖像理解頁面。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai
from PIL import Image
import base64

client = genai.Client()

with open("/path/to/cat_image.png", "rb") as f:
    image_bytes = f.read()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input=[
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "Create a picture of a nano banana dish in a fancy restaurant with a Gemini theme"
        },
        {
            "type": "image",
            "data": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode('utf-8'),
            "mime_type": "image/png"
        }
    ],
)

with open("generated_image.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(interaction.output_image.data))

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as fs from "node:fs";

async function main() {

  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

  const imagePath = "path/to/cat_image.png";
  const imageData = fs.readFileSync(imagePath);
  const base64Image = imageData.toString("base64");

  const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input: [
      { type: "text", text: "Create a picture of my cat eating a nano-banana in a" +
              "fancy restaurant under the Gemini constellation" },
      {
        type: "image",
        mime_type: "image/png",
        data: base64Image
      },
    ],
  });
  const generatedImage = interaction.output_image;
  if (generatedImage) {
    if (generatedImage && generatedImage.data) {
    const buffer = Buffer.from(generatedImage.data, "base64");
    fs.writeFileSync("gemini-native-image.png", buffer);
  }
    console.log("Image saved as gemini-native-image.png");
  }
}

## Nano Banana 的功能

Nano Banana 模型提供最先進的圖像生成與編輯能力。Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 針對速度與高用量情境最佳化，Gemini 3 Pro Image 則針對專業素材製作最佳化。這些模型運用進階推理來處理最具挑戰性的工作流程，特別擅長複雜的多輪建立與修改任務。

  • 高解析度輸出：內建 1K、2K 與 4K 視覺內容的生成能力。

  • Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 新增較小的 512px（0.5K）解析度（Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 不支援）。

  • 進階文字算繪：能為資訊圖表、菜單、圖解與行銷素材生成清晰易讀、風格化的文字。

  • 使用 Google 搜尋接地：模型可將 Google 搜尋作為工具，查核事實並根據即時資料生成圖像（例如目前的天氣圖、股價圖表、近期事件）。

  • Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 除了網路搜尋外，還整合了 Google 圖片搜尋接地。

  • 思考模式：模型運用「思考」流程來推理複雜的提示詞。它會生成中間的「思考圖像」（在後端可見，但不計費），在產出最終高品質成品前先完善構圖。

  • 最多 14 張參考圖像：混合最多 14 張參考圖像來產出最終圖像。

  • 新的長寬比：Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 新增 1:4、4:1、1:8 與 8:1 長寬比。

### 使用 Google 搜尋接地

使用 Google 搜尋工具，根據即時資訊（例如天氣預報、股價圖表或近期事件）生成圖像。

請注意，將 Google 搜尋接地與圖像生成搭配使用時，以圖像為基礎的搜尋結果不會傳遞給生成模型，也會從回應中排除（請見使用 Google 圖片搜尋接地）。

gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image 模型不支援 Google 搜尋接地。

    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input=prompt,
    tools=[{"type": "google_search"}],
    response_format={
        "type": "image",
        "mime_type": "image/jpeg",
        "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
    },
)

docs.title: 使用 Google 搜尋進行圖像接地（Nano Banana 2.1 與 3.1 Flash）{#image-search}
docs.text:
注意：這項功能僅適用於 Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 模型。

使用 Google 圖片搜尋接地，可讓模型將透過 Google 圖片搜尋擷取的網路圖像作為圖像生成的視覺上下文。圖片搜尋是既有的 Google 搜尋接地工具中的一種新搜尋類型，與標準的網路搜尋並行運作。

如要啟用圖片搜尋，請在 API 請求中設定 google_search 工具，並將 image_search 指定於 search_types 陣列中。圖片搜尋可單獨使用，也可與網路搜尋搭配使用。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoREST 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input="A detailed painting of a Timareta butterfly resting on a flower",
    tools=[{
      "type": "google_search",
      "search_types": ["web_search", "image_search"]
    }]
)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

async function main() {
  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

  const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input: "A detailed painting of a Timareta butterfly resting on a flower",
    tools: [{
      "type": "google_search",
      "search_types": ["web_search", "image_search"]
    }]
  });
}

顯示要求

將圖片搜尋用於 Google 搜尋接地時，你必須顯示 search_suggestions（來自 google_search_result 步驟）。完整的使用要求詳見服務條款。

回應

對於使用圖片搜尋的接地回應，API 會在回應步驟中傳回行內引用與出處中繼資料：

  • url_citation 註記：model_output 內文字內容區塊上的行內引用，將生成的內容連結至其來源。

  • google_search_result：包含 search_suggestions，這是一段 HTML 程式碼片段，用於在你的 UI 中算繪搜尋建議。

docs.title: 影片轉圖像生成（Nano Banana 2.1、3.1 Flash 與 3.1 Flash Lite）{#video-to-image}
docs.text:
注意：這項功能僅適用於 Gemini Nano Banana 2.1、Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image 模型。

影片轉圖像生成可讓你以影片的上下文作為多模態參考，生成新的圖像。這適用於製作高品質的影片縮圖、電影海報、摘要資訊圖表，或受影片場景啟發的新作品。

生成過程中，模型會在上下文中分析影片畫面，擷取視覺主題與關鍵事件，再結合你的文字提示詞合成輸出圖像。

你可以在 API 請求中直接傳入公開的 YouTube 網址，或使用 Files API 上傳本機影片檔案。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai
from google.genai import types
import base64

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input=[
        {
            "type": "video",
            "uri": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTdfxFyOQTI",
            "mime_type": "video/mp4"
        },
        {"type": "text", "text": "Generate a poster image that captures the key themes of this video."}
    ],
    response_format={"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}
)

for step in interaction.steps:
    if step.type == "model_output":
        for content_block in step.content:
            if content_block.type == "text":
                print(content_block.text)
            elif content_block.type == "image":
                with open("video_poster.png", "wb") as f:
                    f.write(base64.b64decode(content_block.data))
                print("Image saved as video_poster.png")

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as fs from "node:fs";

async function main() {
  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({});

  const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input: [
      {
        type: "video",
        uri: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTdfxFyOQTI",
        mime_type: "video/mp4"
      },
      { type: "text", text: "Generate a poster image that captures the key themes of this video." }
    ],
    response_format: {
      type: "image",
      aspect_ratio: "16:9"
    }
  });

  for (const step of interaction.steps) {
    if (step.type === "model_output") {
      for (const contentBlock of step.content || []) {
        if (contentBlock.type === "text") {
          console.log(contentBlock.text);
        } else if (contentBlock.type === "image") {
          if (contentBlock.data) {
          const buffer = Buffer.from(contentBlock.data, "base64");
          fs.writeFileSync("video_poster.png", buffer);
        }
          console.log("Image saved as video_poster.png");
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

import java.nio.file.Files;

import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;

Client client = new Client();

Content videoContent =
    VideoContent.builder()
        .uri("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTdfxFyOQTI")
        .mimeType(VideoContentMimeType.VIDEO_MP4)
        .build();
Content textContent =
    TextContent.builder()
        .text("Generate a poster image that captures the key themes of this video.")
        .build();

List<Content> contents = Arrays.asList(videoContent, textContent);

CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat format =
    CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat.of(
        ResponseFormat.of(
            ImageResponseFormat.builder()
                .aspectRatio(ImageResponseFormatAspectRatio.of("16:9"))
                .build()));

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-nano-banana-2.1"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofContent(contents))
        .responseFormat(format)
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

if (interaction.steps().isPresent()) {
  for (Step step : interaction.steps().get()) {
    if (step instanceof ModelOutputStep) {
      ModelOutputStep outputStep = (ModelOutputStep) step;
      if (outputStep.content().isPresent()) {
        for (Content block : outputStep.content().get()) {
          if (block instanceof TextContent) {
            System.out.println(((TextContent) block).text().orElse(""));
          } else if (block instanceof ImageContent) {
            ImageContent img = (ImageContent) block;
            if (img.data().isPresent()) {
              byte[] imgBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(img.data().get());
              Files.write(Paths.get("video_poster.png"), imgBytes);
              System.out.println("Image saved as video_poster.png");
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

### 生成最高 4K 解析度的圖像

Gemini 3 圖像模型預設生成 1K 圖像，但也能輸出 2K、4K 與 512px（05.K）圖像（僅 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image）。如要生成更高解析度的素材，請指定 image_size（位於 response_format 中）。

你必須使用大寫的「K」（例如 512px (05.K)、1K、2K、4K）。小寫參數（例如 1k）會遭到拒絕。

from google.genai import types
import base64

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input=prompt,
    response_format={
        "type": "image",
        "mime_type": "image/jpeg",
        "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
        "image_size": "1K"
    },
)

print(interaction.output_text)

with open("butterfly.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(interaction.output_image.data))

以下是用這個提示詞生成的範例圖像：

### 思考流程

Gemini 3 圖像模型是思考模型，會針對複雜的提示詞運用推理流程（「Thinking」）。這項功能預設啟用，且無法在 API 中停用。如需進一步瞭解思考流程，請參閱 Gemini Thinking 指南。

模型最多會生成兩張中間圖像，用來測試構圖與邏輯。Thinking 中的最後一張圖像同時也是最終算繪的圖像。

你可以查看導出最終圖像的思考內容。

docs.title: 交錯的文字與圖像
docs.text:
標準的圖像生成模型只會輸出圖像，但某些進階的 Gemini 3 模型（例如 gemini-3-pro-image）能在同一個回應中生成交錯的內容，例如同時包含文字區塊與插圖的故事或教學指南。

由於輸出內容複雜且交錯，.output_image 或 .output_text 等便利屬性無法擷取完整的序列。如要存取並儲存交錯內容，你必須手動逐一走訪 steps：

PythonJavaScriptJavaGo 
interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-3-pro-image",

docs.text:
使用 Google 搜尋，根據近期或即時資訊生成圖像。這適用於新聞、天氣與其他時效性主題。

from google import genai
from google.genai import types
import base64

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input="Make a simple but stylish graphic of last night's Arsenal game in the Champion's League",
    tools=[{"type": "google_search"}],
    response_format={"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"},
)

for step in interaction.steps:
    if step.type == "model_output":
        for content_block in step.content:
            if content_block.type == "text":
                print(content_block.text)
            elif content_block.type == "image":

docs.title: 最佳做法
docs.text:
如要讓成果從良好提升到出色，請將這些專業策略納入你的工作流程。

  • 極度具體：你提供的細節越多，掌控程度就越高。不要只寫「奇幻盔甲」，而是這樣描述：「華麗的精靈板甲，蝕刻銀葉圖案，高領，肩甲形狀如獵鷹翅膀。」

  • 提供上下文與意圖：說明圖像的「用途」。模型對上下文的理解會影響最終輸出。例如，「為高級極簡保養品牌建立標誌」會比單寫「建立一個標誌」得到更好的結果。

  • 反覆調整與完善：不要期待第一次就得到完美的圖像。利用模型的對話特性進行小幅修改，接著使用這樣的提示詞：「很好，但可以讓光線再暖一點嗎？」或「其他都保持不變，但把角色的表情改得更嚴肅。」

  • 使用逐步指令：對於元素眾多的複雜場景，將提示詞拆成步驟。「首先，建立一個黎明時寧靜薄霧森林的背景。接著，在前景加一座覆滿苔蘚的古老石祭壇。最後，在祭壇上放一把發光的劍。」

  • 使用「語意負面提示詞」：不要說「不要有車」，而是以正向方式描述想要的場景：「一條空無一人、毫無交通跡象的荒涼街道。」

  • 掌控鏡頭：使用攝影與電影語言來掌控構圖，例如 wide-angle shot、macro shot、low-angle perspective 等術語。

docs.title: 限制
docs.text:
• 為獲得最佳效能，請使用下列語言：EN、ar-EG、de-DE、es-MX、fr-FR、hi-IN、id-ID、it-IT、ja-JP、ko-KR、pt-BR、ru-RU、ua-UA、vi-VN、zh-CN。

  • 圖像生成不支援音訊輸入。影片輸入僅支援 Gemini Nano Banana 2.1、Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image。

  • 模型不一定會完全依照使用者明確要求的圖像輸出數量生成。

  • gemini-2.5-flash-image 最適合以最多 3 張圖像作為輸入；gemini-3-pro-image 支援 5 張高擬真圖像，總計最多 14 張圖像。gemini-nano-banana-2.1 與 gemini-3.1-flash-image 在單一工作流程中，支援最多 4 個角色的相似度與最多 10 個物件的擬真度。

  • 為圖像生成文字時，Gemini 的最佳做法是先生成文字，再要求產生包含該文字的圖像。

  • gemini-nano-banana-2.1 與 gemini-3.1-flash-image 的 Google 搜尋接地目前不支援使用網路搜尋中找到的真人圖像。

  • 所有生成的圖像都包含 SynthID 浮水印。

docs.title: 選用設定
docs.text: 你可以視需要使用 response_format 參數，設定輸出格式、長寬比與圖像大小。

docs.title: 輸出格式
docs.text:
模型預設同時傳回文字與圖像回應。你可以在 response_format 參數中指定圖像格式，將回應設定為只傳回生成的圖像（省略對話文字）。

如要請求多種模態（例如同時傳回文字與生成的圖像），請改為將格式項目陣列傳入 response_format。

    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input="Write a short poem about a starry night and generate an image of it.",
    response_format=[
        {"type": "text"},
        {"type": "image"},
    ],
)

  input: "Write a short poem about a starry night and generate an image of it.",
  response_format: [
    { type: "text" },
    { type: "image" },
  ],
});

docs.title: 長寬比與圖像大小
docs.text:
模型預設會讓輸出圖像大小與你的輸入圖像相符，否則生成 1:1 的正方形圖像。你可以使用 aspect_ratio 與 image_size 欄位（位於 response_format 下），在 type 設為 "image" 時控制輸出圖像的長寬比與大小。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input=prompt,
    response_format={
        "type": "image",
        "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
        "image_size": "2K",
    },
)

const interaction = await ai.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    input: prompt,
    response_format: {
      type: "image",
      aspect_ratio: "16:9",
      image_size: "2K",
    },
  });

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageResponseFormatAspectRatio;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageResponseFormatImageSize;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;

Client client = new Client();
String prompt = "Create a picture of a nano banana dish in a fancy restaurant with a Gemini theme";

CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat format =
    CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat.of(
        ResponseFormat.of(
            ImageResponseFormat.builder()
                .aspectRatio(ImageResponseFormatAspectRatio.of("16:9"))
                .imageSize(ImageResponseFormatImageSize.TWO_K)
                .build()));

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-nano-banana-2.1"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of(prompt))
        .responseFormat(format)
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

package main

import (
    "context"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    prompt := "Create a picture of a nano banana dish in a fancy restaurant with a Gemini theme"

    format := interactions.NewCreateModelInteractionResponseFormat(
        interactions.NewResponseFormat(interactions.ImageResponseFormat{
            AspectRatio: interactions.ImageResponseFormatAspectRatio("16:9").ToPointer(),
            ImageSize:   interactions.ImageResponseFormatImageSizeTwoK.ToPointer(),
        }),
    )

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model:          interactions.Model("gemini-nano-banana-2.1"),
            Input:          interactions.NewInteractionsInput(prompt),
            ResponseFormat: genai.Ptr(format),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    _ = res
}

curl -s -X POST \
  "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    "input": "Create a picture of a nano banana dish in a fancy restaurant with a Gemini theme",
    "response_format": {
      "type": "image",
      "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
      "image_size": "2K"
    }
  }'

gemini-api image "Create a picture of a nano banana dish in a fancy restaurant with a Gemini theme" \
  --aspect-ratio 16:9 \
  --image-size 2K \
  --out generated_image.png

docs.title: 何時使用 Imagen
docs.text:
Imagen 模型已關閉。所有圖像生成任務請使用 Nano Banana 模型。

Imagen 已關閉，不再透過 Gemini API 提供。圖像生成與編輯請使用 Nano Banana。

docs.title: 後續步驟
docs.text:
• 請參閱 Veo 指南，瞭解如何使用 Gemini API 生成影片。

  • 如需進一步瞭解 Gemini 模型，請參閱 Gemini 模型。

docs.title: 圖片理解
docs.text:
Gemini 模型從根本上即以多模態為設計核心，能處理各式各樣的圖片處理與電腦視覺任務，包括但不限於圖片說明生成、分類與視覺問答，且無需另外訓練專門的 ML 模型。

除了一般的多模態能力之外，Gemini 模型還透過額外訓練，針對物件偵測與影像分割等特定用途提供更高的準確度。

docs.title: 將圖片傳給 Gemini
docs.text:
你可以用以下幾種方式將圖片作為輸入提供給 Gemini：

  • 使用 URL 傳遞圖片：適合可公開存取的圖片。
  • 傳遞內嵌圖片資料：適用於 base64 編碼的圖片資料。
  • 使用 File API 上傳圖片：建議用於較大的檔案，或需要在多個請求間重複使用圖片的情況。

docs.title: 使用 URL 傳遞圖片
docs.text:
你可以透過 Files API 上傳圖片，並將其傳入請求中：

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

uploaded_file = client.files.upload(file="path/to/organ.jpg")

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": "Caption this image."},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "uri": uploaded_file.uri,
            "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type
        }
    ]
)
print(interaction.output_text)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});

const uploadedFile = await client.files.upload({
    file: "path/to/organ.jpg",
    config: { mimeType: "image/jpeg" }
});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input: [
        {type: "text", text: "Caption this image."},
        {
            type: "image",
            uri: uploadedFile.uri,
            mime_type: uploadedFile.mimeType
        }
    ]
});
console.log(interaction.output_text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Content;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContentMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import com.google.genai.types.File;
import com.google.genai.types.UploadFileConfig;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

Client client = new Client();

File uploadedFile =
    client.files.upload(
        new java.io.File("path/to/organ.jpg"),
        UploadFileConfig.builder().mimeType("image/jpeg").build());

Content textContent = TextContent.builder().text("Caption this image.").build();
Content imageContent =
    ImageContent.builder()
        .uri(uploadedFile.uri().orElse(""))
        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.of(uploadedFile.mimeType().orElse("image/jpeg")))
        .build();

List<Content> contents = Arrays.asList(textContent, imageContent);

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofContent(contents))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    uploadedFile, err := client.Files.UploadFromPath(ctx, "path/to/organ.jpg", &genai.UploadFileConfig{
        MIMEType: "image/jpeg",
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput([]interactions.Content{
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.TextContent{
                    Text: "Caption this image.",
                }),
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    URI:      genai.Ptr(uploadedFile.URI),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeType(uploadedFile.MIMEType).ToPointer(),
                }),
            }),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": [
      {"type": "text", "text": "Caption this image."},
      {
        "type": "image",
        "uri": "YOUR_FILE_URI",
        "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
      }
    ]
  }'

FILE=$(gemini-api files upload path/to/organ.jpg --wait)
gemini-api analyze "Caption this image." -i "$FILE"

docs.title: 傳遞內嵌圖片資料
docs.text:
你可以將圖片資料以 base64 編碼字串的形式提供：

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
import base64
from google import genai

with open('path/to/small-sample.jpg', 'rb') as f:
    image_bytes = f.read()

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": "Caption this image."},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "data": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode('utf-8'),
            "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
        }
    ]
)
print(interaction.output_text)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as fs from "node:fs";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});
const base64ImageFile = fs.readFileSync("path/to/small-sample.jpg", {
  encoding: "base64",
});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input: [
        {type: "text", text: "Caption this image."},
        {
            type: "image",
            data: base64ImageFile,
            mime_type: "image/jpeg"
        }
    ]
});
console.log(interaction.output_text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Content;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContentMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;

byte[] imageBytes = Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get("path/to/small-sample.jpg"));
String base64Image = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(imageBytes);

Client client = new Client();

Content textContent = TextContent.builder().text("Caption this image.").build();
Content imageContent =
    ImageContent.builder()
        .data(base64Image)
        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.IMAGE_JPEG)
        .build();

List<Content> contents = Arrays.asList(textContent, imageContent);

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofContent(contents))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "encoding/base64"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "os"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    imageBytes, err := os.ReadFile("path/to/small-sample.jpg")
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    base64Image := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imageBytes)

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput([]interactions.Content{
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.TextContent{
                    Text: "Caption this image.",
                }),
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    Data:     genai.Ptr(base64Image),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeTypeImageJpeg.ToPointer(),
                }),
            }),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

IMG_PATH="/path/to/your/image1.jpg"

if [[ "$(base64 --version 2>&1)" = *"FreeBSD"* ]]; then
  B64FLAGS="--input"
else
  B64FLAGS="-w0"
fi

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": [
      {"type": "text", "text": "Caption this image."},
      {
        "type": "image",
        "data": "'"$(base64 $B64FLAGS $IMG_PATH)"'",
        "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
      }
    ]
  }'

gemini-api analyze "Caption this image." -i path/to/small-sample.jpg

使用內嵌圖片資料時，請求總大小（文字提示詞、系統指令與內嵌位元組）上限為 20MB。若請求較大，請透過 File API 上傳圖片檔案。

docs.title: 使用 File API 上傳圖片

client = genai.Client()

my_file = client.files.upload(file="path/to/sample.jpg")

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": "Caption this image."},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "uri": my_file.uri,
            "mime_type": my_file.mime_type
        }
    ]
)
print(interaction.output_text)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});

const myfile = await client.files.upload({
    file: "path/to/sample.jpg",
    config: { mimeType: "image/jpeg" },
});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input: [
        {type: "text", text: "Caption this image."},
        {
            type: "image",
            uri: myfile.uri,
            mime_type: myfile.mimeType
        }
    ]
});

docs.title: 使用多張圖片進行提示
docs.text:
你可以在單一提示詞中提供多張圖片，方法是將多個圖片物件放入 input 陣列：

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": "What is different between these two images?"},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "uri": "https://example.com/image1.jpg",
            "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
        },
        {
            "type": "image",
            "uri": "https://example.com/image2.jpg",
            "mime_type": "image/jpeg"
        }
    ]
)
print(interaction.output_text)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
    model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input: [
        {type: "text", text: "What is different between these two images?"},
        {
            type: "image",
            uri: "https://example.com/image1.jpg",
            mime_type: "image/jpeg"
        },
        {
            type: "image",
            uri: "https://example.com/image2.jpg",
            mime_type: "image/jpeg"
        }
    ]
});
console.log(interaction.output_text);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Content;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContentMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

Client client = new Client();

Content textContent =
    TextContent.builder().text("What is different between these two images?").build();
Content image1 =
    ImageContent.builder()
        .uri("https://example.com/image1.jpg")
        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.IMAGE_JPEG)
        .build();
Content image2 =
    ImageContent.builder()
        .uri("https://example.com/image2.jpg")
        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.IMAGE_JPEG)
        .build();

List<Content> contents = Arrays.asList(textContent, image1, image2);

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofContent(contents))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput([]interactions.Content{
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.TextContent{
                    Text: "What is different between these two images?",
                }),
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    URI:      genai.Ptr("https://example.com/image1.jpg"),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeTypeImageJpeg.ToPointer(),
                }),
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    URI:      genai.Ptr("https://example.com/image2.jpg"),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeTypeImageJpeg.ToPointer(),
                }),
            }),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \

docs.title: 物件偵測
docs.text:
模型經過訓練，能偵測圖片中的物件並取得其邊界框座標。這些座標是相對於圖片尺寸的比例值，範圍為 [0, 1000]。你需要依原始圖片大小，將這些座標還原為實際尺寸。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoRESTCLI 
from google import genai
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List
import json

client = genai.Client()
prompt = "Detect the all of the prominent items in the image. The box_2d should be [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000."

class BoundingBox(BaseModel):
    box_2d: List[int] = Field(description="The 2D bounding box of the item as [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000.")
    mask: List[List[int]] = Field(description="The segmentation mask of the item as a polygon of [x,y] coordinates, normalized to 0-1000.")
    label: str = Field(description="A descriptive label for the item.")

class BoundingBoxes(BaseModel):
    boxes: List[BoundingBox]

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "uri": "https://example.com/image.png",
            "mime_type": "image/png"
        }
    ],
    response_format={
        "type": "text",
        "mime_type": "application/json",
        "schema": BoundingBoxes.model_json_schema()
    }
)

bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxes.model_validate_json(interaction.output_text)
print(bounding_boxes)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as z from "zod";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});
const prompt = "Detect the all of the prominent items in the image. The box_2d should be [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000.";

const boundingBoxesSchema = z.object({
  boxes: z.array(z.object({
    box_2d: z.array(z.number()),
    mask: z.array(z.array(z.number())),
    label: z.string()
  }))
});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: [
    { type: "text", text: prompt },
    {
      type: "image",
      uri: "https://example.com/image.png",
      mime_type: "image/png"
    }
  ],
  response_format: {
    type: 'text',
    mime_type: 'application/json',
    schema: z.toJSONSchema(boundingBoxesSchema)
  },
});

const result = boundingBoxesSchema.parse(JSON.parse(interaction.output_text));
console.log(result);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Content;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ImageContentMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextContent;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.TextResponseFormatMimeType;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

Client client = new Client();
String prompt =
    "Detect the all of the prominent items in the image. The box_2d should be [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000.";

Map<String, Object> boundingBoxSchema =
    Map.of(
        "type", "object",
        "properties",
            Map.of(
                "box_2d",
                    Map.of(
                        "type", "array",
                        "items", Map.of("type", "integer"),
                        "description",
                            "The 2D bounding box of the item as [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000."),
                "mask",
                    Map.of(
                        "type", "array",
                        "items", Map.of("type", "array", "items", Map.of("type", "integer")),
                        "description",
                            "The segmentation mask of the item as a polygon of [x,y] coordinates, normalized to 0-1000."),
                "label",
                    Map.of("type", "string", "description", "A descriptive label for the item.")),
        "required", List.of("box_2d", "mask", "label"));

Map<String, Object> boundingBoxesSchema =
    Map.of(
        "type", "object",
        "properties", Map.of("boxes", Map.of("type", "array", "items", boundingBoxSchema)),
        "required", List.of("boxes"));

CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat format =
    CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat.of(
        ResponseFormat.of(
            TextResponseFormat.builder()
                .mimeType(TextResponseFormatMimeType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .schema(boundingBoxesSchema)
                .build()));

Content textContent = TextContent.builder().text(prompt).build();
Content imageContent =
    ImageContent.builder()
        .uri("https://example.com/image.png")
        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.IMAGE_PNG)
        .build();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofContent(Arrays.asList(textContent, imageContent)))
        .responseFormat(format)
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "google.golang.org/genai"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/interactions"
    "google.golang.org/genai/interactions/models/operations"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client, err := genai.NewClient(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    prompt := "Detect the all of the prominent items in the image. The box_2d should be [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000."

    boundingBoxSchema := map[string]any{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": map[string]any{
            "box_2d": map[string]any{
                "type":        "array",
                "items":       map[string]any{"type": "integer"},
                "description": "The 2D bounding box of the item as [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000.",
            },
            "mask": map[string]any{
                "type":        "array",
                "items":       map[string]any{"type": "array", "items": map[string]any{"type": "integer"}},
                "description": "The segmentation mask of the item as a polygon of [x,y] coordinates, normalized to 0-1000.",
            },
            "label": map[string]any{
                "type":        "string",
                "description": "A descriptive label for the item.",
            },
        },
        "required": []string{"box_2d", "mask", "label"},
    }

    boundingBoxesSchema := map[string]any{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": map[string]any{
            "boxes": map[string]any{
                "type":  "array",
                "items": boundingBoxSchema,
            },
        },
        "required": []string{"boxes"},
    }

    format := interactions.NewCreateModelInteractionResponseFormat(
        interactions.NewResponseFormat(interactions.TextResponseFormat{
            MimeType: interactions.TextResponseFormatMimeTypeApplicationJSON.ToPointer(),
            Schema:   boundingBoxesSchema,
        }),
    )

    res, err := client.Interactions.Create(ctx, operations.CreateInteractionRequest{
        Body: operations.NewCreateInteractionRequestBody(interactions.CreateModelInteraction{
            Model: interactions.Model("gemini-4-hydrogen"),
            Input: interactions.NewInteractionsInput([]interactions.Content{
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.TextContent{
                    Text: prompt,
                }),
                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    URI:      genai.Ptr("https://example.com/image.png"),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeTypeImagePng.ToPointer(),
                }),
            }),
            ResponseFormat: genai.Ptr(format),
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println(*res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}

curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Api-Revision: 2026-05-20" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "input": [
      {"type": "text", "text": "Detect the all of the prominent items in the image. The box_2d should be [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000."},
      {
        "type": "image",
        "uri": "https://example.com/image.png",
        "mime_type": "image/png"
      }
    ],
    "response_format": {
      "type": "text",
      "mime_type": "application/json",
      "schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "boxes": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "box_2d": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "integer" } },
                "mask": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "integer" } } },
                "label": { "type": "string" }
              },
              "required": ["box_2d", "mask", "label"]
            }
          }
        },
        "required": ["boxes"]
      }
    }
  }'

gemini-api generate -i image.png "Detect the all of the prominent items in the image. The box_2d should be [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000." \
  --body '{"response_format": {"type": "text", "mime_type": "application/json", "schema": {
    "type": "object", "required": ["boxes"], "properties": {"boxes": {"type": "array", "items": {
      "type": "object", "required": ["box_2d", "mask", "label"], "properties": {
        "box_2d": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}},
        "mask": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}}},
        "label": {"type": "string"}}}}}}}}'

模型也支援依自訂指令產生邊界框，例如：「顯示這張圖片中所有綠色物件的邊界框」。

docs.title: 影像分割
docs.text:
自 Gemini 2.5 起，模型不只能偵測物件，還能將其分割並提供輪廓遮罩。

模型會預測一份 JSON 清單，其中每個項目代表一個分割遮罩。每個項目包含一個邊界框（「box_2d」），格式為 [y0, x0, y1, x1]，座標已正規化為 0 到 1000 之間；一個用於識別物件的標籤（「label」）；以及位於邊界框內的分割遮罩，其形式為 base64 編碼的 png，是一張數值介於 0 到 255 之間的機率圖。

Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的 thinking_level 預設為 "high"。若要降低大量分割作業的延遲，也可以測試 "low"，或在支援 minimal 思考的模型上使用 "minimal"，例如 gemini-3.5-flash-lite。

PythonJavaScriptJavaGoREST 
from google import genai
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List
import json

client = genai.Client()

prompt = """
Give the segmentation masks for the wooden and glass items.
Output a JSON list of segmentation masks where each entry contains the 2D
bounding box in the key "box_2d", the segmentation mask in key "mask", and
the text label in the key "label". Use descriptive labels.
"""

class BoundingBox(BaseModel):
    box_2d: List[int] = Field(description="The 2D bounding box of the item as [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000.")
    mask: List[List[int]] = Field(description="The segmentation mask of the item as a polygon of [x,y] coordinates, normalized to 0-1000.")
    label: str = Field(description="A descriptive label for the item.")

class BoundingBoxes(BaseModel):
    boxes: List[BoundingBox]

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-4-hydrogen",
    input=[
        {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
        {
            "type": "image",
            "uri": "https://example.com/image.png",
            "mime_type": "image/png"
        }
    ],
    response_format={
        "type": "text",
        "mime_type": "application/json",
        "schema": BoundingBoxes.model_json_schema()
    },
    generation_config={
        "thinking_level": "high"
    }
)

items = BoundingBoxes.model_validate_json(interaction.output_text)
print("Segmentation results:", items)

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import * as z from "zod";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});
const prompt = `
Give the segmentation masks for the wooden and glass items.
Output a JSON list of segmentation masks where each entry contains the 2D
bounding box in the key "box_2d", the segmentation mask in key "mask", and
the text label in the key "label". Use descriptive labels.
`;

const boundingBoxesSchema = z.object({
  boxes: z.array(z.object({
    box_2d: z.array(z.number()),
    mask: z.array(z.array(z.number())),
    label: z.string()
  }))
});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-4-hydrogen",
  input: [
    { type: "text", text: prompt },
    {
      type: "image",
      uri: "https://example.com/image.png",
      mime_type: "image/png"
    }
  ],
  response_format: {
    type: 'text',
    mime_type: 'application/json',
    schema: z.toJSONSchema(boundingBoxesSchema)
  },
  generation_config: {
    thinking_level: "high"
  }
});

const result = boundingBoxesSchema.parse(JSON.parse(interaction.output_text));
console.log(result);

import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Content;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.GenerationConfig;

import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

Client client = new Client();

String prompt =
    "Give the segmentation masks for the wooden and glass items.\n"
        + "Output a JSON list of segmentation masks where each entry contains the 2D\n"
        + "bounding box in the key \"box_2d\", the segmentation mask in key \"mask\", and\n"
        + "the text label in the key \"label\". Use descriptive labels.";

Map<String, Object> boundingBoxSchema =
    Map.of(
        "type", "object",
        "properties",
            Map.of(
                "box_2d",
                    Map.of(
                        "type", "array",
                        "items", Map.of("type", "integer"),
                        "description",
                            "The 2D bounding box of the item as [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000."),
                "mask",
                    Map.of(
                        "type", "array",
                        "items", Map.of("type", "array", "items", Map.of("type", "integer")),
                        "description",
                            "The segmentation mask of the item as a polygon of [x,y] coordinates, normalized to 0-1000."),
                "label",
                    Map.of("type", "string", "description", "A descriptive label for the item.")),
        "required", List.of("box_2d", "mask", "label"));

Map<String, Object> boundingBoxesSchema =
    Map.of(
        "type", "object",
        "properties", Map.of("boxes", Map.of("type", "array", "items", boundingBoxSchema)),
        "required", List.of("boxes"));

CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat format =
    CreateModelInteractionResponseFormat.of(
        ResponseFormat.of(
            TextResponseFormat.builder()
                .mimeType(TextResponseFormatMimeType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .schema(boundingBoxesSchema)
                .build()));

Content textContent = TextContent.builder().text(prompt).build();
Content imageContent =
    ImageContent.builder()
        .uri("https://example.com/image.png")
        .mimeType(ImageContentMimeType.IMAGE_PNG)
        .build();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of("gemini-4-hydrogen"))
        .input(InteractionsInput.ofContent(Arrays.asList(textContent, imageContent)))
        .responseFormat(format)
        .generationConfig(GenerationConfig.builder().thinkingLevel(ThinkingLevel.HIGH).build())
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();
System.out.println("Segmentation results: " + interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

                interactions.NewContent(interactions.ImageContent{
                    URI:      genai.Ptr("https://example.com/image.png"),
                    MimeType: interactions.ImageContentMimeTypeImagePng.ToPointer(),
                }),
            }),
            ResponseFormat: genai.Ptr(format),
            GenerationConfig: &interactions.GenerationConfig{
                ThinkingLevel: interactions.ThinkingLevelHigh.ToPointer(),
            },
        }),
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    if res.Interaction.OutputText != nil {
        fmt.Println("Segmentation results: " + *res.Interaction.OutputText)
    }
}
